meta.examples_source: deepseek 改写（初一难度）+ 中文翻译

examples.en: The children ate up all the cakes quickly.
examples.zh: 孩子们很快吃光了所有的蛋糕。

examples.en: Please eat up your vegetables before you leave.
examples.zh: 离开前请把你的蔬菜吃完。

examples.en: He ate up his lunch and then went to play.
examples.zh: 他吃完了午饭，然后去玩了。

examples.en: She is a creative artist who paints well.
examples.zh: 她是一位画得很好的有创造力的艺术家。

examples.en: He has creative abilities to solve problems.
examples.zh: 他有解决问題的创造能力。

examples.en: Creative thinking helps us find new ways.
examples.zh: 创造性思考帮助我们找到新方法。

examples.en: I was curious to know the next thing.
examples.zh: 我很好奇接下来会发生什么。

examples.en: Babies are curious about everything around them.
examples.zh: 婴儿对周围的一切都很好奇。

examples.en: Why did you ask? I was just curious.
examples.zh: 你为什么问？我只是好奇。

examples.en: She is an energetic young woman who loves sports.
examples.zh: 她是一个精力充沛、热爱运动的年轻女子。

examples.en: I tried aerobics, but it was too energetic for me.
examples.zh: 我试过有氧操，但它对我来说太耗精力了。

examples.en: The dancers' energetic show made everyone happy.
examples.zh: 舞者们充满活力的表演让每个人都开心。

examples.en: They are rich, but they live in a modest house.
examples.zh: 他们虽然富有，但住在朴素的房子里。

examples.en: The housing conditions for the poor have had a modest improvement.
examples.zh: 穷人的住房条件有了小幅改善。

examples.en: The party made modest gains in the election, not big ones.
examples.zh: 这个党在选举中只获得小幅进展，而不是大胜。

examples.en: The letters were put in organized piles.
examples.zh: 这些信被放成一堆堆整齐的。

examples.en: She is not organized and is often late.
examples.zh: 她没条理，还经常迟到。

examples.en: He is kind but he is not organized.
examples.zh: 他善良，但没条理。

examples.en: The students organised a school clean-up day.
examples.zh: 学生们组织了一个学校大扫除日。

examples.en: She is very organised and finishes her homework early.
examples.zh: 她很有条理，总是早早完成作业。

examples.en: We organised a party for the new classmate.
examples.zh: 我们为新闻学组织了一个派对。

examples.en: The waiter asked, "Can I take your order now?"
examples.zh: 服务员问道：“您现在可以点餐了吗？”

examples.en: I want to place an order for a big table.
examples.zh: 我想下订单买一张大桌子。

examples.en: An email said my order was sent.
examples.zh: 一封邮件说我的订单已经发货了。

examples.en: She keeps her desk in order every day.
examples.zh: 她每天把自己的书桌保持得井然有序。

examples.en: Please keep the classroom in order.
examples.zh: 请保持教室整洁有序。

examples.en: He kept his tools in order after work.
examples.zh: 他下班后把工具摆放得整整齐齐。

examples.en: He always shows off his new watch in class.
examples.zh: 他总是在班上炫耀他的新手表。

examples.en: Stop showing off your good grades to us.
examples.zh: 别向我们炫耀你的好成绩了。

examples.en: She showed off her dancing skills at the party.
examples.zh: 她在聚会上炫耀了她的舞技。

examples.en: A German grammar is a book about German rules.
examples.zh: 一本德语语法书是讲德语规则的书。

examples.en: These books cover grammar very well for us.
examples.zh: 这些书把语法讲得很好，对我们很有用。

examples.en: Schools here care a lot about writing and grammar.
examples.zh: 这里的学校很重视写作和语法。

examples.en: She came up with a good idea for the party.
examples.zh: 她想出了一个聚会的好主意。

examples.en: Can you come up with a new game to play?
examples.zh: 你能想出一个新游戏来玩吗？

examples.en: He came up with an answer very quickly.
examples.zh: 他很快想出了一个答案。

examples.en: We have two TVs, but neither works well.
examples.zh: 我们有两台电视，但两台都不好用。

examples.en: Neither of my parents likes my boyfriend.
examples.zh: 我父母都不喜欢我的男朋友。

examples.en: Neither of us is interested in gardening.
examples.zh: 我们俩都对园艺不感兴趣。

examples.en: We can't change it, nor can we improve it.
examples.zh: 我们无法改变它，也无法改进它。

examples.en: Neither Carlo nor Juan saw what happened.
examples.zh: 卡洛和胡安都没有看到发生了什么。

examples.en: I've never been to Iceland. Nor have I.
examples.zh: 我从未去过冰岛。我也没去过。

examples.en: Neither Tom nor Mary likes swimming.
examples.zh: 汤姆和玛丽都不喜欢游泳。

examples.en: I can neither sing nor dance.
examples.zh: 我既不会唱歌也不会跳舞。

examples.en: She neither called nor wrote to me.
examples.zh: 她既没打电话也没写信给我。

examples.en: My father is an accountant in a big firm.
examples.zh: 我爸爸是一家大公司的会计。

examples.en: The accountant checks the money for us.
examples.zh: 会计为我们查账。

examples.en: She wants to be an accountant after school.
examples.zh: 她毕业后想当会计。

examples.en: She was born in 1950.
examples.zh: 她出生于1950年。

examples.en: More babies are born with AIDS now.
examples.zh: 现在有更多婴儿出生时就患有艾滋病。

examples.en: Stevie Wonder was born blind.
examples.zh: 史蒂维·旺德天生失明。

examples.en: I was impressed with her many toys when I was a child.
examples.zh: 我小时候对她有这么多玩具印象很深。

examples.en: Your mother was not impressed by our behavior in the restaurant.
examples.zh: 你妈妈对我们在这家餐厅的行为不满意。

examples.en: He tried to impress me with his knowledge of wine.
examples.zh: 他试图用他对葡萄酒的知识给我留下好印象。

examples.en: Tom teaches sculpture at the local art school.
examples.zh: 汤姆在当地艺术学校教雕塑。

examples.en: The museum has some life-sized sculptures of people and animals.
examples.zh: 博物馆有一些真人大小的动物和人物雕像。

examples.en: This tall sculpture is her new work.
examples.zh: 这座高大的雕塑是她的新作品。

examples.en: He should be praised for being honest.
examples.zh: 他应该因为诚实而受到表扬。

examples.en: My parents praised me when I did well at school.
examples.zh: 我在学校表现好时，父母表扬了我。

examples.en: He was highly praised for his study on heart disease.
examples.zh: 他因对心脏病的研究而受到高度赞扬。

examples.en: The sales department sent us a new report yesterday.
examples.zh: 销售部昨天给我们发了一份新报告。

examples.en: She works in the sales department and sells computers.
examples.zh: 她在销售部工作，卖电脑。

examples.en: Please call the sales department if you need more information.
examples.zh: 如果你需要更多信息，请给销售部打电话。

examples.en: The general feeling is that the result was unfair.
examples.zh: 普遍的感觉是结果不公平。

examples.en: There is general worry about more crime in cities.
examples.zh: 人们普遍担心城市里犯罪更多。

examples.en: My general impression of that place was nice.
examples.zh: 我对那个地方的总体印象很好。

examples.en: Do you know who won the horse race?
examples.zh: 你知道谁赢了赛马比赛吗？

examples.en: I was happy to win the race yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天赢了比赛，我很开心。

examples.en: I lost the race to a faster runner today.
examples.zh: 今天我输给了一个更快的跑步者。

examples.en: You can either call me or send an email.
examples.zh: 你要么给我打电话，要么发邮件。

examples.en: Either you or your brother has to clean the room.
examples.zh: 不是你就是你弟弟必须打扫房间。

examples.en: We will either go to the park or stay at home.
examples.zh: 我们要么去公园，要么待在家里。

examples.en: I think we chose the right person to lead the trip.
examples.zh: 我觉得我们选对了人带队这次旅行。

examples.en: I asked Gemma to lead the talk.
examples.zh: 我请格玛来主持这次讨论。

examples.en: Who will lead the look into the accident?
examples.zh: 谁将来负责调查这起事故？

examples.en: Our class took the lead in the sports meeting.
examples.zh: 我们班在运动会上处于领先地位。

examples.en: She takes the lead in the English speech contest.
examples.zh: 她在英语演讲比赛中处于领先地位。

examples.en: The team took the lead and won the game at last.
examples.zh: 这支队伍处于领先地位，最后赢得了比赛。

examples.en: If you don't study hard, you will fall behind in class.
examples.zh: 如果你不努力学习，你就会在班上落后。

examples.en: He fell behind the others during the race.
examples.zh: 他在比赛中落后于其他人。

examples.en: Don't fall behind in your homework.
examples.zh: 别在作业上落后了。

examples.en: Scientists face a big challenge to solve this problem.
examples.zh: 科学家们面临解决这个问题的巨大挑战。

examples.en: You know me, I enjoy a challenge.
examples.zh: 你知道我的，我喜欢挑战。

examples.en: The job is hard, but she will rise to the challenge.
examples.zh: 这份工作很难，但她会迎接挑战。

examples.en: The chief problem here is the disease spread.
examples.zh: 这里的主要问题是疾病传播。

examples.en: Weather was our chief reason to come.
examples.zh: 天气是我们来的主要原因。

examples.en: My chief worry is stopping the disease.
examples.zh: 我主要的担心是阻止这种疾病。

examples.en: He drove too fast and went off the road at a high-speed bend.
examples.zh: 他开得太快，在高速弯道处冲出了路面。

examples.en: Lions can't keep high-speed running for long when hunting.
examples.zh: 狮子捕猎时不能长时间保持高速奔跑。

examples.en: Turn the fan to high speed, please.
examples.zh: 请把风扇调到高速。

examples.en: Can I connect my printer to your computer?
examples.zh: 我能把打印机连接到你的电脑上吗？

examples.en: Where does the stove connect to the power?
examples.zh: 炉子在哪里接通电源？

examples.en: Is the internet connected in your new home yet?
examples.zh: 你的新家通网了吗？

examples.en: Please connect your phone to the computer.
examples.zh: 请把你的手机连接到电脑上。

examples.en: This road connects my town with the city.
examples.zh: 这条路把我的小镇和城市连接起来。

examples.en: I connected with my old friend on the Internet.
examples.zh: 我在网上和我的老朋友取得了联系。

examples.en: I missed the class start because my bus was late.
examples.zh: 因为公交车晚了，我错过了上课的开始。

examples.en: I often miss breakfast and have an early lunch.
examples.zh: 我经常不吃早餐，而是提前吃午饭。

examples.en: Leave early to miss the rush hour.
examples.zh: 早点出发以避开交通高峰期。

examples.en: The old bike is as good as new after I cleaned it.
examples.zh: 这辆旧自行车在我清洗后几乎和新的一样。

examples.en: He is as good as dead if he doesn't wear a helmet.
examples.zh: 如果他不戴头盔，他简直是必死无疑。

examples.en: Her English is as good as a native speaker's now.
examples.zh: 她的英语现在和母语者几乎一样好。

examples.en: Please wait, and I will give you my full attention.
examples.zh: 请等一下，我会把全部注意力放在你身上。

examples.en: Children often have a short attention span.
examples.zh: 孩子们通常注意力持续时间很短。

examples.en: They plan a campaign to draw attention to car pollution.
examples.zh: 他们计划一场活动来引起人们对汽车污染的关注。

examples.en: Please pay attention to the teacher in class.
examples.zh: 请在课堂上注意听老师讲课。

examples.en: You should pay attention to your spelling.
examples.zh: 你应该注意你的拼写。

examples.en: She paid attention to the road while driving.
examples.zh: 她开车时注意着路面。

examples.en: This essay is not up to standard. Please do it again.
examples.zh: 这篇作文不达标，请重写。

examples.en: This piece of work is below standard.
examples.zh: 这份作业低于标准。

examples.en: I'm sorry, but this meal is not up to standard.
examples.zh: 很抱歉，这顿饭不达标。

examples.en: He is a pioneer of modern science.
examples.zh: 他是现代科学的先驱之一。

examples.en: She is a pioneer heart doctor.
examples.zh: 她是一位心脏外科的开拓者医生。

examples.en: The pioneers moved west and cut down trees.
examples.zh: 开拓者们向西迁徙并砍伐树木。

examples.en: The surgeon makes a small cut and puts in a tube.
examples.zh: 外科大夫切一个小口，然后放入一根管子。

examples.en: Winifred wanted her daughter to be a surgeon.
examples.zh: 温妮弗雷德希望她女儿成为外科大夫。

examples.en: The surgeon tried her best to save him.
examples.zh: 外科大夫尽了她最大的努力去救他。

examples.en: Human carelessness caused most forest fires this spring.
examples.zh: 这个春天，大多数森林火灾都是人为粗心造成的。

examples.en: A little carelessness may cost an animal its life.
examples.zh: 一点粗心可能会让动物失去生命。

examples.en: Frostbite often comes from poor clothing or carelessness.
examples.zh: 冻伤常常是因为衣服不够暖或粗心造成的。

examples.en: If you need extra help, just call me.
examples.zh: 如果你需要额外的帮助，就给我打电话。

examples.en: He works an extra two hours every day now.
examples.zh: 他现在每天多工作两个小时。

examples.en: Travel and room are in the price, but meals are extra.
examples.zh: 价格包含交通和住宿，但餐费另付。

examples.en: He left his job to devote more time to his family.
examples.zh: 他辞去工作，把更多时间用在家人身上。

examples.en: She devoted her life to helping homeless people.
examples.zh: 她把一生都用来帮助无家可归的人。

examples.en: At 25, he decided to devote himself to God.
examples.zh: 25岁时，他决定献身于上帝。

examples.en: I respect his ideas, even though I don't agree with them.
examples.zh: 我尊重他的想法，即使我不同意这些想法。

examples.en: She is a strong person and everyone respects her.
examples.zh: 她是一个坚强的人，大家都尊敬她。

examples.en: New teachers must work hard to earn students' respect.
examples.zh: 新老师必须努力工作才能赢得学生的尊敬。

examples.en: The film is not suitable for kids.
examples.zh: 这部电影不适合孩子们看。

examples.en: We planned a meeting, but it was hard to find a suitable place.
examples.zh: 我们计划了会议，但很难找到合适的地方。

examples.en: Each room has books and toys suitable for its age group.
examples.zh: 每个房间都有适合其年龄段的书和玩具。

examples.en: He left the police after his partner died.
examples.zh: 搭档死后，他离开了警察工作。

examples.en: The two companies are partners to build the new factory.
examples.zh: 这两家公司是合作伙伴，一起建新工厂。

examples.en: He is a partner in an insurance company.
examples.zh: 他是一家保险公司的合伙人。

examples.en: He's a good teacher, but he is a bit impatient with slow students.
examples.zh: 他是个好老师，但对学得慢的学生有点不耐烦。

examples.en: You can't look after kids. You're too impatient!
examples.zh: 你没法照顾孩子。你太没耐心了！

examples.en: He gets angry easily. He is too impatient to be a teacher.
examples.zh: 他很容易生气。他太急躁，不适合当老师。

examples.en: You should think twice about spending all your money.
examples.zh: 你应该三思而后行，别把钱都花光。

examples.en: She thought twice about joining the club after the meeting.
examples.zh: 会议后，她再三考虑是否加入这个俱乐部。

examples.en: Think twice about telling him the secret.
examples.zh: 把秘密告诉他之前，请三思。

examples.en: After dinner, I always do the dishes with my mom.
examples.zh: 晚饭后，我总是和妈妈一起洗碗。

examples.en: He did the dishes quickly before watching TV.
examples.zh: 他在看电视前很快洗了碗。

examples.en: Please do the dishes when you finish your homework.
examples.zh: 你完成作业后请洗碗。

examples.en: We can see the lunar surface at night.
examples.zh: 我们晚上能看到月球表面。

examples.en: A lunar eclipse happens when the earth is between the sun and the moon.
examples.zh: 当太阳和月球之间隔着地球时，就会发生月食。

examples.en: The lunar rocks are gray and light.
examples.zh: 月球岩石是灰色的，而且很轻。

examples.en: An old 2012 calendar still hung on her office wall.
examples.zh: 一本旧的2012年挂历还挂在她办公室的墙上。

examples.en: He put the meeting date in his calendar.
examples.zh: 他把会议日期记在了日历上。

examples.en: The Chinese calendar is different from the Western one.
examples.zh: 中国日历和西方日历不同。

examples.en: My animal sign is the dragon, and I was born in 2012.
examples.zh: 我的生肖是龙，我出生于2012年。

examples.en: Do you know the animal signs in the Chinese calendar?
examples.zh: 你知道中国日历里的生肖吗？

examples.en: Each animal sign has its own special story in Chinese culture.
examples.zh: 每个生肖在中国文化中都有自己特别的故事。

examples.en: They chose a famous lawyer to represent them in court.
examples.zh: 他们选了一位著名律师在法庭上代表他们。

examples.en: Teachers' union leaders met the government today.
examples.zh: 教师工会领导今天会见了政府。

examples.en: I sent my husband to represent me at the funeral.
examples.zh: 我派我丈夫代表我参加葬礼。

examples.en: He appeared in the doorway suddenly.
examples.zh: 他突然出现在门口。

examples.en: Dark spots began to appear on our wall a month later.
examples.zh: 一个月后，我们的墙上开始出现黑点。

examples.en: His name appears in the film's lighting credits.
examples.zh: 他的名字出现在电影的灯光字幕里。

examples.en: The shop sells goods at a fixed price.
examples.zh: 这家商店以固定的价格出售商品。

examples.en: The bank gives us fixed interest rates.
examples.zh: 银行给我们固定的利率。

examples.en: Is the wedding date fixed yet?
examples.zh: 婚礼的日期确定了吗？

examples.en: You can't take your cycle on this train.
examples.zh: 你不能把自行车带上这趟火车。

examples.en: A thousand people joined the biggest cycle race here.
examples.zh: 一千人参加了这里最大的自行车比赛。

examples.en: You can lock your cycle here safely.
examples.zh: 你可以在这里安全地锁好你的自行车。

examples.en: There are fifty students in all in our class.
examples.zh: 我们班总共有五十名学生。

examples.en: We spent two hours in all on the homework.
examples.zh: 我们做家庭作业总共花了两个小时。

examples.en: She bought ten books in all yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天总共买了十本书。

examples.en: What's your star sign? I'm a Leo.
examples.zh: 你是什么星座？我是狮子座。

examples.en: My star sign is Virgo, so I like to be neat.
examples.zh: 我的星座是处女座，所以我喜欢整洁。

examples.en: She checked her star sign online every day.
examples.zh: 她每天都上网查她的星座。

examples.en: At the end of class, please divide into small groups.
examples.zh: 下课前，请分成小组。

examples.en: After the war, Germany was divided into two countries.
examples.zh: 战后，德国被分成两个国家。

examples.en: Let's divide the money equally among us.
examples.zh: 我们大家平分这些钱吧。

examples.en: The teacher divides the class into four groups.
examples.zh: 老师把班级分成四个小组。

examples.en: We divided the cake into eight pieces.
examples.zh: 我们把蛋糕分成了八块。

examples.en: Please divide the apples into two baskets.
examples.zh: 请把这些苹果分成两篮。

examples.en: The president is more powerful than the prime minister.
examples.zh: 总统比总理更有权力。

examples.en: She is the most powerful person in the group.
examples.zh: 她是这个团体中最有权力的人。

examples.en: The president is powerful enough to control the government.
examples.zh: 总统强大到足以控制政府。

examples.en: Clay can be shaped into many things.
examples.zh: 黏土可以做成很多形状。

examples.en: These bricks come in different shapes.
examples.zh: 这些砖头有不同的形状。

examples.en: Kim's birthday cake was in the shape of a train.
examples.zh: Kim的生日蛋糕是火车形状的。

examples.en: Kids usually start to speak in their second year.
examples.zh: 孩子们通常在第二年学会说话。

examples.en: A stroke can cause people to lose their speech.
examples.zh: 中风会使人们失去说话能力。

examples.en: His speech was unclear, so I thought he was drunk.
examples.zh: 他说话含糊不清，我以为他喝醉了。

examples.en: John has been absent from school for three days.
examples.zh: 约翰已经三天没来学校了。

examples.en: We drank to our absent friends.
examples.zh: 我们为缺席的朋友们干杯。

examples.en: If you are absent for over three days, bring a doctor's note.
examples.zh: 如果你缺席超过三天，需要带医生证明。

examples.en: UN monitors could not go into the area.
examples.zh: 联合国观察员不能进入那个地区。

examples.en: Rosie was picked as class monitor that day.
examples.zh: 那天罗茜被选为班长。

examples.en: They work as monitors to check the group obeys the law.
examples.zh: 他们当监督员，检查这个组织遵守法律。

examples.en: I found our position on the map. You can see where we are.
examples.zh: 我在地图上找到了我们的位置。你可以看到我们在哪里。

examples.en: You moved the sofa. Its position is different now.
examples.zh: 你移动了沙发。现在它的位置不同了。

examples.en: You play hockey. What position do you play?
examples.zh: 你打曲棍球。你打什么位置？

examples.en: I agree with you about the movie.
examples.zh: 关于这部电影，我同意你的看法。

examples.en: She agreed with her friend on the plan.
examples.zh: 她同意朋友关于这个计划的看法。

examples.en: Do you agree with him on this question?
examples.zh: 在这个问题上，你同意他的看法吗？

examples.en: The women used indigo to dye the cotton.
examples.zh: 女人们用靛蓝给棉花染色。

examples.en: The blue dye was a kind of synthetic indigo.
examples.zh: 这种蓝色染料是一种合成的靛蓝。

examples.en: The main crop was indigo, a plant for blue dye.
examples.zh: 主要作物是靛蓝，一种用来做蓝色染料的植物。

examples.en: Please write your name in violet ink.
examples.zh: 请用紫罗兰色的墨水写你的名字。

examples.en: Violet is too dark for these walls.
examples.zh: 紫罗兰色对这些墙来说太暗了。

examples.en: She wore a violet dress to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件紫罗兰色的连衣裙去参加聚会。

examples.en: The sun came out, and we saw a rainbow.
examples.zh: 太阳出来了，我们看到了彩虹。

examples.en: The butterfly's wings shone like a rainbow.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶的翅膀像彩虹一样闪闪发光。

examples.en: The prisms will make rainbows on the wall.
examples.zh: 这些棱镜会在墙上形成彩虹。

examples.en: After talking with Stella, I was in a good mood all day.
examples.zh: 和斯特拉谈过之后，我一整天心情都很好。

examples.en: She is in a bad mood this morning.
examples.zh: 她今天早上心情不好。

examples.en: He was in a foul mood after losing the game.
examples.zh: 他输了比赛后，心情很糟糕。

examples.en: Family is the most important influence on children.
examples.zh: 家庭对孩子的影响最重要。

examples.en: Helen is a bad influence on him.
examples.zh: 海伦对他有坏影响。

examples.en: He has a big influence on the city council.
examples.zh: 他对市议会有很大的影响力。

examples.en: I didn't know whether you would like it.
examples.zh: 我不确定你是否会喜欢它。

examples.en: She asked me whether I wanted to work for her.
examples.zh: 她问我是否想为她工作。

examples.en: I'm thinking about whether to eat fish or beef.
examples.zh: 我在想是吃鱼还是吃牛肉。

examples.en: Sadly, a big nose is a family characteristic.
examples.zh: 遗憾的是，大鼻子是这个家庭的特征。

examples.en: Being sentimental is a characteristic of writers then.
examples.zh: 感伤是那个时期作家们的共同特征。

examples.en: The male bird has characteristics different from the female.
examples.zh: 雄鸟有与雌鸟不同的特征。

examples.en: Keep calm, everyone. The police are coming.
examples.zh: 大家保持镇静，警察就要来了。

examples.en: He usually stays calm in meetings, but this time he got angry.
examples.zh: 他开会时通常很镇静，但这次他生气了。

examples.en: Please stay calm and leave the building in order.
examples.zh: 请保持镇静，有序离开大楼。

examples.en: She looked relaxed and knew what to do.
examples.zh: 她看起来很放松，而且知道该怎么做。

examples.en: After the massage, I felt very relaxed.
examples.zh: 按摩之后，我感觉非常放松。

examples.en: After the long holiday, I was relaxed and ready to work.
examples.zh: 长假过后，我放松了，也准备好去工作了。

examples.en: Europe had peace for 20 years after 1918, then war came again.
examples.zh: 1918年后欧洲和平了20年，然后战争又来了。

examples.en: Now the war is over, we may have lasting peace between our countries.
examples.zh: 现在战争结束了，我们两国之间可能会有持久的和平。

examples.en: The two sides are having peace talks to stop the fighting.
examples.zh: 双方正在进行和平谈判以停止战斗。

examples.en: Her sadness was clear when her grandfather died.
examples.zh: 她祖父去世时，她的悲伤显而易见。

examples.en: She talked about her sadness after her father died.
examples.zh: 她谈到父亲去世后她的悲伤。

examples.en: We learned of Joan's death with great sadness.
examples.zh: 我们怀着巨大的悲伤得知了琼的死讯。

examples.en: People killed others because they wanted racial purity.
examples.zh: 人们因为想要种族纯洁而杀害他人。

examples.en: The purity of her voice made us feel calm.
examples.zh: 她嗓音的纯洁让我们感到平静。

examples.en: We should check the purity of air and water.
examples.zh: 我们应该检查空气和水的纯净度。

examples.en: Do you know when Caroline and Matthew's wedding is?
examples.zh: 你知道卡罗琳和马修的婚礼是什么时候吗？

examples.en: They will eat the wedding cake at the party.
examples.zh: 他们会在聚会上吃婚礼蛋糕。

examples.en: She wore a white wedding dress yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天穿了一件白色的婚纱。

examples.en: Do you prefer hot or cold weather?
examples.zh: 你喜欢热天气还是冷天气？

examples.en: I prefer tea to coffee.
examples.zh: 比起咖啡，我更喜欢茶。

examples.en: He prefers watching games to playing them.
examples.zh: 比起亲自比赛，他更喜欢看比赛。

examples.en: Charles Schulz created Snoopy and Charlie Brown.
examples.zh: 查尔斯·舒尔茨创造了史努比和查理·布朗。

examples.en: The Bible says God created the world.
examples.zh: 《圣经》说上帝创造了世界。

examples.en: He created a great meal from few things.
examples.zh: 他用很少的食材做出了一顿美餐。

examples.en: I had a tingling feeling in my fingers.
examples.zh: 我的手指有一种刺痛的感觉。

examples.en: I have a strange feeling in my stomach.
examples.zh: 我肚子里有一种奇怪的感觉。

examples.en: My toes were so cold that I lost all feeling in them.
examples.zh: 我的脚趾太冷了，以至于完全失去了知觉。

examples.en: She cheered up when she heard the good news.
examples.zh: 她听到好消息时振作了起来。

examples.en: Let's cheer up the sad boy with some funny stories.
examples.zh: 我们用一些有趣的故事让那个伤心的男孩振作起来吧。

examples.en: He cheered up after winning the game.
examples.zh: 赢得比赛后，他振作起来了。

examples.en: Can you remind Paul about dinner on Saturday?
examples.zh: 你能提醒保罗周六的晚餐吗？

examples.en: Please remind me to mail this letter.
examples.zh: 请提醒我寄这封信。

examples.en: I reminded Jane that the meeting was off.
examples.zh: 我提醒简会议取消了。

examples.en: Conventional wisdom says women are more emotional than men, but I don't think so.
examples.zh: 传统智慧认为女性比男性更情绪化，但我不这么认为。

examples.en: Popular wisdom says we have fewer holidays than most European countries, but is that true?
examples.zh: 大众智慧说我们的假期比大多数欧洲国家少，但这是真的吗？

examples.en: Received wisdom tells us financial markets work well, but we should question it.
examples.zh: 公认的智慧告诉我们金融市场运作良好，但我们应该质疑它。

examples.en: She will soon be as tall as her mother.
examples.zh: 她很快会和她妈妈一样高了。

examples.en: I can't run as fast as you.
examples.zh: 我没法跑得和你一样快。

examples.en: Her skin is as soft as a baby's.
examples.zh: 她的皮肤和婴儿的一样柔软。

examples.en: I envy her for making friends easily.
examples.zh: 我羡慕她能轻松交到朋友。

examples.en: I don't envy you cooking for everyone.
examples.zh: 我不羡慕你为大家做饭。

examples.en: His workmates envy his big wealth.
examples.zh: 他的同事们羡慕他的巨额财富。

examples.en: She was green with envy when she saw my new bike.
examples.zh: 她看到我的新自行车时非常眼红。

examples.en: He felt green with envy after his friend won the prize.
examples.zh: 他的朋友获奖后，他感到十分妒忌。

examples.en: Don't be green with envy; you can do it too.
examples.zh: 别眼红，你也能做到的。

examples.en: Call us if you require more info.
examples.zh: 如果你需要更多信息，请给我们打电话。

examples.en: Fast skiing requires full attention.
examples.zh: 快速滑雪需要全神贯注。

examples.en: Raising kids requires you to put them first.
examples.zh: 养育孩子要求你把他们放在第一位。

examples.en: She had the strength to lead and win the gold medal.
examples.zh: 她有力量去领先并赢得金牌。

examples.en: Admitting your mistake shows strength, not weakness.
examples.zh: 承认错误显示的是力量，不是软弱。

examples.en: He showed strength of character by refusing the bribes.
examples.zh: 他拒绝贿赂，表现出了品格的力量。

examples.en: The heat of the sun is strong today.
examples.zh: 今天太阳的热度很强。

examples.en: How can you work in this heat with no AC?
examples.zh: 没有空调，你怎么能在这么热的天工作？

examples.en: She wore a coat even in the summer heat.
examples.zh: 即使在夏天的炎热中，她也穿着外套。

examples.en: We finished the job, but with great difficulty.
examples.zh: 我们完成了工作，但非常费力。

examples.en: The difficulty of the task excited them.
examples.zh: 这项任务的困难让他们兴奋。

examples.en: She had great difficulty finding a job.
examples.zh: 她找工作很困难。

examples.en: I have difficulty in understanding this math problem.
examples.zh: 我理解这道数学题很费劲。

examples.en: She had difficulty finding her keys this morning.
examples.zh: 她今天早上找钥匙很费劲。

examples.en: They have difficulty speaking English in public.
examples.zh: 他们在公共场合说英语很费劲。

examples.en: She has to make a hard decision now.
examples.zh: 她现在必须做一个艰难的决定。

examples.en: The company will reach a decision soon.
examples.zh: 公司很快会做出决定。

examples.en: She thought more before coming to a decision.
examples.zh: 她思考更多后才做出决定。

examples.en: Scientists found the relationship between smoking and lung cancer.
examples.zh: 科学家发现了吸烟和肺癌之间的关系。

examples.en: Her relationship with her father is bad, but she is close to her mother.
examples.zh: 她和父亲的关系不好，但她和母亲很亲近。

examples.en: No trust can destroy a relationship.
examples.zh: 没有信任会毁掉一段关系。

examples.en: She certainly had a friend Mark, but I don't know if he was her boyfriend.
examples.zh: 她确实有一个叫马克的朋友，但我不知道他是不是她的男朋友。

examples.en: This question is hard. Yes, it's certainly not easy.
examples.zh: 这个问题很难。是的，当然不容易。

examples.en: Should we give more money to education? Certainly!
examples.zh: 我们应该给教育更多钱吗？当然！

examples.en: Everyday life is busy for most people.
examples.zh: 对大多数人来说，日常生活很忙碌。

examples.en: Death was an everyday thing during the war.
examples.zh: 战争期间，死亡是每天都会发生的事。

examples.en: He made everyday objects into art pieces.
examples.zh: 他把日常物品变成了艺术品。

examples.en: My personal opinion is that students need more outdoor work.
examples.zh: 我的个人观点是学生需要更多的户外活动。

examples.en: Her personal view is different from her workmates'.
examples.zh: 她的个人看法和同事们的不同。

examples.en: Her uncle has a personal interest in her progress.
examples.zh: 她叔叔对她的进步有个人兴趣。

examples.en: He wore a blue three-piece suit to the party.
examples.zh: 他穿了一套蓝色的三件套西装去参加派对。

examples.en: She bought a new two-piece suit for her job interview.
examples.zh: 她为工作面试买了一套新的两件套西装。

examples.en: He wore a black dinner suit to the formal dinner.
examples.zh: 他穿了一套黑色晚礼服去参加正式晚宴。

examples.en: People had lively New Year celebrations all over town.
examples.zh: 全镇的人们都举行了热闹的新年庆祝活动。

examples.en: Such good news calls for a celebration!
examples.zh: 这么好的消息值得庆祝一下！

examples.en: Let's buy some drinks in celebration of her safe arrival.
examples.zh: 我们买点饮料庆祝她安全到达吧。

examples.en: Ancient history teaches us to trust our neighbors.
examples.zh: 古代历史教我们要信任邻居。

examples.en: People have lived in this valley since ancient times.
examples.zh: 人们自古以来就住在这个山谷里。

examples.en: I have always liked ancient history.
examples.zh: 我一直很喜欢古代历史。

examples.en: Occupational therapy helps patients do daily tasks again.
examples.zh: 职业疗法帮助病人重新做日常事务。

examples.en: Speech therapy can improve a student's speaking skills.
examples.zh: 言语疗法能提高学生的说话能力。

examples.en: Group therapy lets people share feelings and support each other.
examples.zh: 集体疗法让人们分享感受并互相支持。

examples.en: Who discovered America first?
examples.zh: 谁最先发现了美洲？

examples.en: We looked for the papers all morning and discovered them in a drawer.
examples.zh: 我们找了那些文件一早上，最后在抽屉里发现了它们。

examples.en: Scientists have discovered how to predict an earthquake.
examples.zh: 科学家们已经发现了如何预测地震。

examples.en: Both my daughters are in their teens.
examples.zh: 我的两个女儿都是十几岁。

examples.en: He is in his early teens now.
examples.zh: 他现在才十三四岁。

examples.en: Tomorrow's temperature will be in the teens.
examples.zh: 明天的温度会是十几度。

examples.en: He promised to call me every week.
examples.zh: 他承诺每周给我打电话。

examples.en: The government promised to reduce taxes.
examples.zh: 政府承诺减税。

examples.en: Promise me you won't tell him.
examples.zh: 答应我你不会告诉他。

examples.en: Is today Tuesday or Wednesday?
examples.zh: 今天是星期二还是星期三？

examples.en: You can pay now or when you come back.
examples.zh: 你可以现在付款，或者回来时再付。

examples.en: Are you listening to me or not?
examples.zh: 你到底有没有在听我说话？

examples.en: I have so much work to do today.
examples.zh: 我今天有好多工作要做。

examples.en: Carrying heavy bags all day is hard work.
examples.zh: 整天搬重袋子是辛苦的工作。

examples.en: What time do you start work in the morning?
examples.zh: 你早上几点开始工作？

examples.en: I play tennis well, but I need to practise my serve.
examples.zh: 我网球打得好，但我需要练习发球。

examples.en: She practises the violin every day.
examples.zh: 她每天练习拉小提琴。

examples.en: His French writing is good, but he needs to practise speaking it.
examples.zh: 他的法语写作不错，但他需要练习说法语。

examples.en: She feels stressed because her new job is hard.
examples.zh: 她因为新工作很难而感到压力很大。

examples.en: I felt stressed before the big tests.
examples.zh: 大考前我感到很紧张。

examples.en: Grandparents often have more time for kids than stressed parents do.
examples.zh: 祖父母通常比压力大的父母有更多时间陪孩子。

examples.en: I suggested a restaurant near the station for the party.
examples.zh: 我建议聚会去车站附近的一家餐厅。

examples.en: May I suggest a white wine with your fish, sir?
examples.zh: 先生，我可以建议您用白葡萄酒配鱼吗？

examples.en: I suggest that we wait a while before deciding.
examples.zh: 我建议我们等一等再做决定。

examples.en: I would rather stay at home than go out.
examples.zh: 我宁愿待在家里，也不愿出去。

examples.en: She would rather read books than watch TV.
examples.zh: 她宁愿看书，也不愿看电视。

examples.en: He would rather walk to school than take the bus.
examples.zh: 他宁愿走路去学校，也不愿坐公交车。

examples.en: My sister told me not to trust him.
examples.zh: 我姐姐叫我不要信任他。

examples.en: Trust me, I know these things well.
examples.zh: 相信我，我很了解这些事。

examples.en: Trust yourself and do what is right.
examples.zh: 信任自己，做正确的事。

examples.en: I wear a T-shirt under my sweater for extra warmth.
examples.zh: 我在毛衣里面穿了件T恤，为了更暖和。

examples.en: It was so cold that we stayed close for warmth.
examples.zh: 天太冷了，我们靠在一起取暖。

examples.en: We stood close together to feel the warmth.
examples.zh: 我们紧挨着站在一起，感受温暖。

examples.en: My handbag is too full of stuff.
examples.zh: 我的手提包装了太多东西。

examples.en: She took a brush out of her handbag and brushed her hair.
examples.zh: 她从手提包里拿出一把梳子，梳了梳头发。

examples.en: Someone snatched her handbag in the street.
examples.zh: 在街上有人抢了她的手提包。

examples.en: We watched a tennis match yesterday.
examples.zh: 我们昨天看了一场网球比赛。

examples.en: He played in a football match last week.
examples.zh: 他上周参加了一场足球比赛。

examples.en: Our team won the match by two goals.
examples.zh: 我们队以两球赢得了比赛。

examples.en: The little boy lost his balance and fell down.
examples.zh: 小男孩失去平衡摔倒了。

examples.en: She held the wall to keep her balance.
examples.zh: 她扶着墙以保持平衡。

examples.en: The ears help us maintain our balance.
examples.zh: 耳朵帮助我们保持平衡。

examples.en: My teenage nephew likes playing basketball.
examples.zh: 我十几岁的侄子喜欢打篮球。

examples.en: Teenage girls often talk about music and clothes.
examples.zh: 十几岁的女孩常谈论音乐和衣服。

examples.en: She reads teenage magazines after school.
examples.zh: 她放学后看青少年杂志。

examples.en: She wiped her hands on her trousers, leaving dirty marks on them.
examples.zh: 她在裤子上擦手，留下了脏痕。

examples.en: His fingers left marks on the shiny table.
examples.zh: 他的手指在闪亮的桌子上留下了痕迹。

examples.en: She had a red mark on her arm from the burn.
examples.zh: 她的胳膊上有一块被烧伤的红印。

examples.en: You're mad to walk home alone at night.
examples.zh: 你晚上一个人走回家，真是疯了。

examples.en: He must be mad to spend all that money on a coat.
examples.zh: 他花了那么多钱买一件外套，一定是疯了。

examples.en: Some things she does are completely mad.
examples.zh: 她做的有些事完全疯了。

examples.en: The loud noise from the street drives me mad.
examples.zh: 街上的吵闹声让我受不了。

examples.en: Waiting for the bus for an hour drove us mad.
examples.zh: 等公交车等了一个小时，让我们受不了了。

examples.en: His bad habits are driving his mother mad.
examples.zh: 他的坏习惯正让他妈妈受不了。

examples.en: American students ranked fourth in the geography exam.
examples.zh: 美国学生在地理考试中排名第四。

examples.en: I failed my physics exam, but I passed chemistry.
examples.zh: 我物理考试没及格，但化学及格了。

examples.en: The passing score for the exam changes every year.
examples.zh: 考试的及格分数每年都变化。

examples.en: He hasn't written to me recently. Perhaps he lost my address.
examples.zh: 他最近没给我写信。或许他弄丢了我的地址。

examples.en: Perhaps the most important question is not asked yet.
examples.zh: 或许最重要的问题还没有被问出来。

examples.en: We plan to travel to Europe, perhaps Spain or Italy.
examples.zh: 我们计划去欧洲旅行，或许是西班牙或意大利。

examples.en: I have a business deal idea for you.
examples.zh: 我有一个商业交易的想法给你。

examples.en: The unions and bosses made a two-year pay deal.
examples.zh: 工会和老板们达成了一项为期两年的薪资协议。

examples.en: The management did a deal to keep the business running.
examples.zh: 管理层做了一笔交易，让企业继续运营。

examples.en: She has too much homework to deal with today.
examples.zh: 她今天有太多作业要处理。

examples.en: We need to deal with this problem right now.
examples.zh: 我们现在需要处理这个问题。

examples.en: He is learning how to deal with stress before exams.
examples.zh: 他正在学习考试前如何应对压力。

examples.en: If it doesn't work, you can choose a refund or a new one.
examples.zh: 如果它不能用，你可以选择退款或换一个新的。

examples.en: It's a hard choice to make.
examples.zh: 这是一个很难做的选择。

examples.en: The choice is yours, so please decide.
examples.zh: 选择是你的，所以请你决定。

examples.en: She is a painter, but she is also a writer.
examples.zh: 她是一位画家，但她也是一位作家。

examples.en: She is hard-working, but she is not imaginative.
examples.zh: 她很努力，但没有想象力。

examples.en: This is not from evil, but from ignorance.
examples.zh: 这不是出于恶意，而是出于无知。

examples.en: I stayed up late to finish my homework last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我熬夜完成了作业。

examples.en: Don't stay up too late, or you will feel tired tomorrow.
examples.zh: 不要熬夜太晚，否则明天你会感到累。

examples.en: She stayed up watching TV until midnight.
examples.zh: 她熬夜看电视一直到午夜。

examples.en: Is Oliver awake now? Yes, he is very awake and running in his room.
examples.zh: 奥利弗现在醒了吗？是的，他非常清醒，在房间里跑来跑去。

examples.en: It is very hard for me to stay awake in history class.
examples.zh: 历史课上保持清醒对我来说很难。

examples.en: I drink much coffee to keep myself awake.
examples.zh: 我喝很多咖啡保持清醒。

examples.en: I could hardly hear her at the back.
examples.zh: 我在后面几乎听不见她说话。

examples.en: The party had hardly started when she left.
examples.zh: 聚会刚开始她就离开了。

examples.en: He hardly ate anything at dinner.
examples.zh: 他晚饭几乎没吃什么东西。

examples.en: Imagine Robert Redford when he was young; John looks like him.
examples.zh: 想象一下年轻的罗伯特·雷德福，约翰长得就像他。

examples.en: Imagine you are eating ice cream and feel how cold it is.
examples.zh: 想象你在吃冰淇淋，感受一下它有多冷。

examples.en: Can you imagine how it feels to be blind?
examples.zh: 你能想象失明是什么感觉吗？

examples.en: I have doubts about his ability to do the job.
examples.zh: 我怀疑他做这份工作的能力。

examples.en: If there is any doubt about the rocket's engines, we should cancel the launch.
examples.zh: 如果对火箭发动机有任何怀疑，我们就应该取消发射。

examples.en: The company's actions made people doubt its ability to save the business.
examples.zh: 公司的行为让人们怀疑它拯救这家企业的能力。

examples.en: Our house is worth 200,000 pounds.
examples.zh: 我们的房子值二十万英镑。

examples.en: The police took drugs worth 5 million dollars.
examples.zh: 警察缴获了价值五百万美元的毒品。

examples.en: She is worth half a million dollars.
examples.zh: 她拥有五十万美元的身价。

examples.en: This movie is worth watching again.
examples.zh: 这部电影值得再看一遍。

examples.en: The book is worth reading carefully.
examples.zh: 这本书值得仔细阅读。

examples.en: It is worth trying the new restaurant.
examples.zh: 值得去试试那家新餐馆。

examples.en: I don't know what to wear. Do you have any suggestions?
examples.zh: 我不知道穿什么。你有什么建议吗？

examples.en: Her suggestions were helpful, but her boss said no to all.
examples.zh: 她的建议很有用，但她老板全都拒绝了。

examples.en: My suggestion was that we all share the cost, but they didn't like it.
examples.zh: 我的建议是我们平摊费用，但他们不喜欢。

examples.en: The police still want to find the cause of the fire.
examples.zh: 警方仍然想查明火灾的原因。

examples.en: She died from natural causes.
examples.zh: 她死于自然原因。

examples.en: I won't tell you without a good cause.
examples.zh: 没有正当理由，我不会告诉你。

examples.en: My parents were strict with me when I was young.
examples.zh: 我小时候，父母对我很严格。

examples.en: Stricter rules on air pollution can reduce acid rain.
examples.zh: 更严格的空气污染规定可以减少酸雨。

examples.en: The city has a strict curfew from night to morning.
examples.zh: 这个城市从夜晚到早上有严格的宵禁。

examples.en: Our math teacher is very strict with us in class.
examples.zh: 我们的数学老师在课堂上对我们要求很严格。

examples.en: My parents are strict with me about my homework.
examples.zh: 我的父母对我的作业要求很严格。

examples.en: She was strict with her students but they loved her.
examples.zh: 她对她的学生们要求严格，但他们喜欢她。

examples.en: We stayed out late to watch the stars last night.
examples.zh: 我们昨晚待在户外看星星，很晚才回家。

examples.en: My parents don't want me to stay out after dark.
examples.zh: 我父母不想让我天黑后待在外面不回家。

examples.en: She stayed out with her friends until ten o'clock.
examples.zh: 她和朋友们待在外面，一直到十点才回家。

examples.en: Does competing with others make schoolwork more fun for you?
examples.zh: 和别人竞争会让你的课业更有趣吗？

examples.en: Competing with classmates can make schoolwork more interesting.
examples.zh: 和同学竞争能让课业变得更有趣。

examples.en: Do you enjoy your schoolwork when you compete with others?
examples.zh: 当你和别人竞争时，你享受你的课业吗？

examples.en: These old things are very valuable.
examples.zh: 这些旧东西非常贵重。

examples.en: This is making the company lose valuable business.
examples.zh: 这正在让公司失去宝贵的生意。

examples.en: Tin and diamonds are the country's most valuable things.
examples.zh: 锡和钻石是这个国家最宝贵的东西。

examples.en: Their friendship started when they were at school together.
examples.zh: 他们的友谊始于他们一起上学的时候。

examples.en: He finds it hard to form friendships.
examples.zh: 他觉得交朋友很难。

examples.en: They made a lifelong friendship from that meeting.
examples.zh: 那次见面让他们结下了终生的友谊。

examples.en: I made a list of places to visit in Paris.
examples.zh: 我列了一张在巴黎要参观的地方的清单。

examples.en: A shopping list can help you save money.
examples.zh: 购物清单能帮你省钱。

examples.en: Is your name on the list?
examples.zh: 你的名字在清单上吗？

examples.en: Can you work out the answer to this math problem?
examples.zh: 你能算出这道数学题的答案吗？

examples.en: They worked out the plan together last night.
examples.zh: 他们昨晚一起解决了这个计划。

examples.en: I finally worked out how to use the new machine.
examples.zh: 我终于弄清楚了如何使用这台新机器。

examples.en: According to Sarah, they aren't getting along well now.
examples.zh: 根据莎拉的说法，他们现在相处得不太好。

examples.en: According to our records, you owe us 130 dollars.
examples.zh: 根据我们的记录，你欠我们130美元。

examples.en: According to reports, the ceasefire is still working.
examples.zh: 根据报道，停火协议仍然有效。

examples.en: This is the teacher whom I like best.
examples.zh: 这是我最喜欢的老师。

examples.en: She has a friend whom she often helps.
examples.zh: 她有一个她经常帮助的朋友。

examples.en: I know the boy whom you talked to.
examples.zh: 我认识你和他说话的那个男孩。

examples.en: A loud thunder sound broke the silence at night.
examples.zh: 一声响雷打破了夜晚的寂静。

examples.en: There was total silence in the church.
examples.zh: 教堂里一片寂静。

examples.en: The conductor waited for complete silence before starting the show.
examples.zh: 指挥等到全场完全安静下来才开始演出。

examples.en: Don't worry, there is nothing you can do now.
examples.zh: 别担心，现在你什么也做不了。

examples.en: Don't worry, she will be fine.
examples.zh: 别担心，她会没事的。

examples.en: It's silly to worry about things you can't control.
examples.zh: 担心你无法控制的事情是傻的。

examples.en: Train travel is a safe method of transport.
examples.zh: 坐火车旅行是一种安全的交通方式。

examples.en: New teaching methods help kids think alone.
examples.zh: 新的教学方法帮助孩子们独立思考。

examples.en: That method failed, so let's try your way.
examples.zh: 那个方法没成功，所以我们试试你的办法。

examples.en: We must work together to solve this problem.
examples.zh: 我们必须一起努力来解决这个问题。

examples.en: Can you solve this puzzle in five minutes?
examples.zh: 你能在五分钟内解出这个谜题吗？

examples.en: Don't cry—crying won't solve anything.
examples.zh: 别哭了——哭解决不了任何问题。

examples.en: I have a French-English dictionary for my English class.
examples.zh: 我有一本法英词典，用于英语课。

examples.en: This is a bilingual dictionary, not a monolingual one.
examples.zh: 这是一本双语词典，不是单语词典。

examples.en: If you don't know the spelling, look it up in a dictionary.
examples.zh: 如果你不知道拼写，就查一下字典。

examples.en: The youth worker talks to gangs in the town.
examples.zh: 这位青少年辅导员和镇上的帮派谈话。

examples.en: Fewer youth workers work because of budget cuts.
examples.zh: 由于预算削减，青少年辅导员变少了。

examples.en: The money will help a youth worker stop kids from doing crime.
examples.zh: 这些钱将帮助青少年辅导员阻止孩子们犯罪。

examples.en: I asked him where he was going. "Home," he replied.
examples.zh: 我问他要去哪里。他回答：“回家。”

examples.en: I replied that it was twelve o'clock.
examples.zh: 我回答说是十二点钟。

examples.en: I try to reply to letters on the day I get them.
examples.zh: 我尽量在收到信的那天回复。

examples.en: She learned chemistry and physics in college.
examples.zh: 她在大学学习了化学和物理。

examples.en: This is the chemistry lab at our school.
examples.zh: 这是我们学校的化学实验室。

examples.en: Scientists are studying the chemistry of the ozone layer.
examples.zh: 科学家们正在研究臭氧层的化学特性。

examples.en: Don't laugh at others' mistakes.
examples.zh: 不要嘲笑别人的错误。

examples.en: The boys laughed at the old man's hat.
examples.zh: 男孩们嘲笑那位老人的帽子。

examples.en: She felt sad when they laughed at her answer.
examples.zh: 当他们嘲笑她的答案时，她感到难过。

examples.en: He was not a bookworm, but he could learn from books and teachers faster than most boys.
examples.zh: 他不是书呆子，但他从书本和老师那里学东西比大多数男孩都快。

examples.en: I am a kind of bookworm myself.
examples.zh: 我自己也算是个书虫。

examples.en: Leo and I were not bookworms, and we didn't love sports as much as some boys.
examples.zh: 利奥和我不是书呆子，我们也不像一些男孩那样那么喜欢运动。

examples.en: Technology progress has been very fast in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来，科技进展非常快。

examples.en: I am not making much progress in my Spanish.
examples.zh: 我的西班牙语进步不大。

examples.en: The doctor said she was making good progress.
examples.zh: 医生说她恢复得很好。

examples.en: When he heard about the accident, he was worried sick.
examples.zh: 当他听说那场事故时，他担心得要命。

examples.en: She sat at her desk with a worried look on her face.
examples.zh: 她坐在桌前，脸上带着担忧的表情。

examples.en: He had a worried expression after the test.
examples.zh: 考试后，他脸上露出担心的神情。

examples.en: Let's go over the new words before the test.
examples.zh: 考试前我们复习一下新单词吧。

examples.en: She went over her notes after class.
examples.zh: 她课后回顾了她的笔记。

examples.en: Please go over the questions and check your answers.
examples.zh: 请回顾这些问题并检查你的答案。

examples.en: He read her letter aloud to his family.
examples.zh: 他大声地把她的信读给家人听。

examples.en: People are asking aloud if the reforms are too much.
examples.zh: 人们大声地问改革是否太过分了。

examples.en: It is good practice to say the speech aloud.
examples.zh: 把演讲大声说出来是个好练习。

examples.en: How do you pronounce your last name?
examples.zh: 你的姓怎么发音？

examples.en: She pronounced his name so wrong he didn't know it.
examples.zh: 她把他的名字发错音了，他都没听出来。

examples.en: Sade, pronounced shah-day, is a singer.
examples.zh: 萨德，发音为shah-day，是一位歌手。

examples.en: Did I say your name correctly?
examples.zh: 我说对你的名字了吗？

examples.en: Answer this question correctly and you may win a car!
examples.zh: 正确回答这个问题，你就有机会赢得一辆车！

examples.en: My mom took speech lessons to speak correctly.
examples.zh: 我妈妈上过演讲课，为了能正确说话。

examples.en: English pronunciation is very hard to learn.
examples.zh: 英语发音很难学。

examples.en: This word has two different pronunciations.
examples.zh: 这个单词有两种不同的发音。

examples.en: Students said it helped when the teacher fixed their pronunciation.
examples.zh: 学生们说老师纠正他们的发音很有帮助。

examples.en: I will mention your ideas to Jacinta.
examples.zh: 我会向雅辛塔提及你的想法。

examples.en: Did she mention me in her letter?
examples.zh: 她在信里提到我了吗？

examples.en: I promised not to mention that thing again.
examples.zh: 我答应过不再提那件事了。

examples.en: Don't mention it; I was happy to help you.
examples.zh: 不客气，我很高兴能帮你。

examples.en: Thanks for the ride. Don't mention it.
examples.zh: 谢谢你载我一程。不客气。

examples.en: Don't mention it, it was no trouble at all.
examples.zh: 不客气，这根本不算麻烦。

examples.en: People under stress may have headaches and trouble sleeping.
examples.zh: 有压力的人可能会头痛或睡不好觉。

examples.en: Yoga is a good way to fight stress.
examples.zh: 瑜伽是应对压力的好方法。

examples.en: How do you get over the stress of the day?
examples.zh: 你如何消除一天的压力？

examples.en: She is of my age, so we are in the same class.
examples.zh: 她与我同龄，所以我们在同一个班。

examples.en: The boy of your age can solve this math problem.
examples.zh: 像你这个年龄的男孩能解出这道数学题。

examples.en: We were of the same age when we met in 2018.
examples.zh: 2018年我们相遇时，我们同龄。

examples.en: My final exam is on my mind all the time.
examples.zh: 期末考试一直挂在我心上。

examples.en: She has a problem on her mind, so she looks worried.
examples.zh: 她心里惦念着一个问题，所以看起来忧心忡忡。

examples.en: Don't let that argument stay on your mind too long.
examples.zh: 别让那次争吵在你心上停留太久。

examples.en: He wants to spend more time with his family.
examples.zh: 他想花更多时间和家人在一起。

examples.en: Time passes so quickly when you're having fun.
examples.zh: 当你玩得开心时，时间过得真快。

examples.en: As time goes on, she likes the subject more.
examples.zh: 随着时间推移，她越来越喜欢这门学科。

examples.en: Whenever I think about it, I blush.
examples.zh: 每当我想到这件事，我就会脸红。

examples.en: Whenever I go there, they seem asleep.
examples.zh: 每次我去那里，他们好像都在睡觉。

examples.en: I use olive oil whenever possible.
examples.zh: 只要有可能，我就用橄榄油。

examples.en: They walked slowly through the woods.
examples.zh: 他们慢慢地穿过树林。

examples.en: The boy walked through the water to get his boat.
examples.zh: 男孩穿过水去拿他的小船。

examples.en: He pushed through the crowd to the front.
examples.zh: 他挤过人群到达前面。

examples.en: I will call you as soon as I get home.
examples.zh: 我一到家就给你打电话。

examples.en: She started to cry as soon as she saw the movie.
examples.zh: 她一看到这部电影就哭了起来。

examples.en: As soon as the bell rings, we can go out to play.
examples.zh: 铃声一响，我们就可以出去玩。

examples.en: She spends a great deal of time on homework every day.
examples.zh: 她每天花大量时间做作业。

examples.en: There is a great deal of water in the river after rain.
examples.zh: 雨后河里有大量的水。

examples.en: He knows a great deal about Chinese history.
examples.zh: 他对中国历史了解很多。

examples.en: I studied at a junior high school for three years.
examples.zh: 我在初级中学学习了三年。

examples.en: My brother is a student at the local junior high.
examples.zh: 我弟弟是当地初中的学生。

examples.en: She teaches English in a junior high school.
examples.zh: 她在一所初级中学教英语。

examples.en: She tried out for the school basketball team yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天参加了学校篮球队的选拔。

examples.en: Many students want to try out for the singing competition.
examples.zh: 许多学生想参加歌唱比赛的选拔。

examples.en: He will try out for the lead role in the play.
examples.zh: 他将参加这部戏剧主角的试演。

examples.en: Don't lose heart even if the test is hard.
examples.zh: 即使考试很难，也不要灰心。

examples.en: He lost heart after failing the math exam.
examples.zh: 数学考试不及格后，他泄气了。

examples.en: She never loses heart when she makes mistakes.
examples.zh: 她犯错时从不灰心。

examples.en: Tennant scored at the end of the game.
examples.zh: 坦南特在比赛结束时得了一分。

examples.en: She scored over twenty goals for her team this season.
examples.zh: 这个赛季她为球队进了二十多个球。

examples.en: In American football, a touchdown scores six points.
examples.zh: 在美式足球中，一次达阵得六分。

examples.en: My brother will enter senior high next September.
examples.zh: 我哥哥明年九月将进入高中。

examples.en: She studies hard at senior high to get good grades.
examples.zh: 她在高中努力学习以取得好成绩。

examples.en: After senior high, he wants to go to college.
examples.zh: 高中毕业后，他想上大学。

examples.en: Granny says her ankles hurt if she stands too long.
examples.zh: 奶奶说，如果她站得太久，脚踝会疼。

examples.en: You should stand up when she comes in to be polite.
examples.zh: 她进来时你应该站起来，以示礼貌。

examples.en: Stand still and keep quiet, please.
examples.zh: 请站好别动，保持安静。

examples.en: She changed her mind and took the bus instead.
examples.zh: 她改变了主意，改乘公交车了。

examples.en: I may change my mind if you give me a good reason.
examples.zh: 如果你给我一个好理由，我可能会改变主意。

examples.en: He changed his mind about going to the party.
examples.zh: 他改变了去参加聚会的主意。

examples.en: She is a leader in our class.
examples.zh: 她是我们班的领导者。

examples.en: The leader of the team is very kind.
examples.zh: 这个队的领导者很和善。

examples.en: He became a leader after hard work.
examples.zh: 经过努力，他成为了一位领导者。

examples.en: Hi, what's your name? My name is Diane.
examples.zh: 嗨，你叫什么名字？我叫黛安。

examples.en: Please write your full name on the form.
examples.zh: 请把你的全名写在表格上。

examples.en: We have a list of names and addresses.
examples.zh: 我们有一份姓名和地址的名单。

examples.en: Which university did you go to?
examples.zh: 你上的是哪所大学？

examples.en: Which university were you at?
examples.zh: 你当时在哪所大学？

examples.en: Most students enjoy studying at university.
examples.zh: 大多数学生喜欢在大学学习。

examples.en: You look simply beautiful in that dress.
examples.zh: 你穿那条裙子简直太美了。

examples.en: The hunger there is terrible, quite simply no other word.
examples.zh: 那里的饥饿很可怕，简直没有别的词来形容。

examples.en: I don't like my job; I simply do it for money.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢我的工作，我只是为了钱而做。

examples.en: After high school, she studied at a junior college for two years.
examples.zh: 高中毕业后，她在一所两年制专科学校学习了两年。

examples.en: My brother wants to go to a junior college to learn computer skills.
examples.zh: 我哥哥想上两年制专科学校学习电脑技能。

examples.en: He finished junior college and then found a good job.
examples.zh: 他读完两年制专科学校，然后找到了一份好工作。

examples.en: We don't work on this national holiday.
examples.zh: 这个国家假日我们不上班。

examples.en: Britain has many national newspapers.
examples.zh: 英国有很多全国性报纸。

examples.en: The company's national office is in Rome.
examples.zh: 这家公司的国家总部在罗马。

examples.en: The British Diving Championship starts next week.
examples.zh: 英国跳水锦标赛下周开始。

examples.en: The world championship will be in Scotland next year.
examples.zh: 世界锦标赛明年将在苏格兰举行。

examples.en: He has played in tennis championships for three years.
examples.zh: 他参加网球锦标赛已经三年了。

examples.en: She tried for six years and finally succeeded in passing her driving test.
examples.zh: 她努力了六年，终于成功通过了驾照考试。

examples.en: You must be strong to succeed in the property business.
examples.zh: 在房地产业，你必须坚强才能成功。

examples.en: The campaign succeeded in making people know the problem better.
examples.zh: 这场活动成功让人们对这个问题有了更多了解。

examples.en: She succeeded in passing the math exam.
examples.zh: 她成功地通过了数学考试。

examples.en: He succeeded in finishing the project on time.
examples.zh: 他成功地按时完成了这个项目。

examples.en: They succeeded in winning the basketball game.
examples.zh: 他们成功地赢得了篮球比赛。

examples.en: This book shows great scholarship.
examples.zh: 这本书展现了很高的学术水平。

examples.en: He won a scholarship to Harvard.
examples.zh: 他获得了哈佛大学的奖学金。

examples.en: Paula studied music on a scholarship.
examples.zh: 保拉靠奖学金学习音乐。

examples.en: Although she knew it was dangerous, she walked home alone.
examples.zh: 尽管她知道危险，她还是独自走回了家。

examples.en: Although I begged him not to go, he still went.
examples.zh: 尽管我求他不要去，他还是去了。

examples.en: Although he is shy, he is better than before.
examples.zh: 尽管他害羞，但他比以前好多了。

examples.en: She is a graduate of Cambridge University.
examples.zh: 她是剑桥大学的毕业生。

examples.en: Chris graduated with a degree in physics.
examples.zh: 克里斯毕业于物理专业。

examples.en: Many high-school graduates go to college.
examples.zh: 许多高中毕业生去上大学。

examples.en: The wind's force blew down many trees here.
examples.zh: 风力把这里许多树都吹倒了。

examples.en: She slapped his face with great force.
examples.zh: 她用力打了他一巴掌。

examples.en: Teachers cannot use force in class.
examples.zh: 老师不能在课堂上使用暴力。

examples.en: Who do you think will win the league this year?
examples.zh: 你认为今年谁会赢得联赛冠军？

examples.en: Liverpool were top of the league that year.
examples.zh: 那年利物浦在联赛中排名第一。

examples.en: The team got to the top of the league last year.
examples.zh: 去年这支队伍登上了联赛榜首。

examples.en: The doctor told him to remain in bed for a few days.
examples.zh: 医生让他卧床几天。

examples.en: Most people think the tax rate will remain at 25%.
examples.zh: 大多数人认为税率将保持在25%。

examples.en: Many things remain to be done before we leave.
examples.zh: 在我们离开之前，还有很多事要做。

examples.en: Please take notice of the sign on the wall.
examples.zh: 请注意墙上的标志。

examples.en: She took notice of his new haircut at once.
examples.zh: 她立刻注意到了他的新发型。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to take notice of the spelling mistakes.
examples.zh: 老师要求我们注意拼写错误。

examples.en: Finishing a long book gives you a sense of achievement.
examples.zh: 读完一本长书给你一种成就感。

examples.en: Winning an Olympic silver medal is a great achievement for a young player.
examples.zh: 赢得奥运银牌对年轻选手来说是一项巨大的成就。

examples.en: The Tale of Genji is seen as the greatest achievement in Japanese literature.
examples.zh: 《源氏物语》被视为日本文学最伟大的成就。

examples.en: The operation proved a great success.
examples.zh: 这次手术证明非常成功。

examples.en: The song rights problem proved hard to solve.
examples.zh: 歌曲版权的问题证明很难解决。

examples.en: The new treatment proved to be a disaster.
examples.zh: 这种新疗法证明是一场灾难。

examples.en: Can I talk to you about a personal matter?
examples.zh: 我能和你谈一件私事吗？

examples.en: Allen said he knew nothing about the matter.
examples.zh: 艾伦说他对此事一无所知。

examples.en: Please call me back - this matter is very important.
examples.zh: 请给我回电话——这件事非常重要。

examples.en: Let's put the bed against the wall, OK?
examples.zh: 我们把床靠墙放，好吗？

examples.en: He felt her soft hair against his face.
examples.zh: 他感觉到她柔软的头发贴着他的脸。

examples.en: The rain beat against her face in the wind.
examples.zh: 雨中，雨水打在她的脸上。

examples.en: A fire broke out in our school last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我们学校突然发生了火灾。

examples.en: The war broke out in 1939.
examples.zh: 战争于1939年爆发。

examples.en: Don't worry, a fight won't break out here.
examples.zh: 别担心，这里不会打起架来。

examples.en: Cliff Richard recorded more hit songs than other British pop stars.
examples.zh: 克里夫·理查德录制的热门歌曲比英国其他流行歌星都多。

examples.en: We recorded their wedding on video.
examples.zh: 我们把他们的婚礼用视频记录了下来。

examples.en: I called her, but got a recorded message saying she was away.
examples.zh: 我给她打电话，但只听到一段录音留言，说她外出了。

examples.en: A heart shape is the symbol of love.
examples.zh: 心形是爱的象征。

examples.en: The wheel in the Indian flag is a symbol of peace.
examples.zh: 印度国旗上的轮子是和平的象征。

examples.en: Water is a symbol of life and appears often in her poems.
examples.zh: 水是生命的象征，常在诗中出现。

examples.en: We opened the season with a big 25-3 victory over Detroit.
examples.zh: 我们以25比3的大比分战胜底特律，开启了本赛季。

examples.en: Grant got an easy victory over Cooper in yesterday's match.
examples.zh: 格兰特在昨天的比赛中轻松战胜了库珀。

examples.en: This result is a great victory for our freedom.
examples.zh: 这个结果是我们自由的一次伟大胜利。

examples.en: The players show strong team spirit.
examples.zh: 球员们表现出强烈的团队精神。

examples.en: They were part of the spirit of the 1960s.
examples.zh: 他们是20世纪60年代时代精神的一部分。

examples.en: We worked with a spirit of cooperation.
examples.zh: 我们怀着合作的精神工作。

examples.en: My family is Jewish, but we are not practising Jews.
examples.zh: 我家是犹太家庭，但我们不是严格信奉犹太教的犹太人。

examples.en: Some Jews live in this area.
examples.zh: 一些犹太人住在这个地区。

examples.en: Both my grandfathers were Jews.
examples.zh: 我的两个祖父都是犹太人。

examples.en: The thief went into hiding after the robbery.
examples.zh: 小偷抢劫后躲藏起来了。

examples.en: They went into hiding to escape the storm.
examples.zh: 他们躲藏起来以躲避风暴。

examples.en: The spy has gone into hiding in the mountains.
examples.zh: 间谍已经躲藏在山里了。

examples.en: A Nazi officer stood at the gate.
examples.zh: 一名纳粹军官站在门口。

examples.en: Nazi Germany started the war.
examples.zh: 纳粹德国发动了这场战争。

examples.en: His grandfather was a Nazi officer in the war.
examples.zh: 他的祖父在战争期间是一名纳粹军官。

examples.en: The old man died of a heart attack last night.
examples.zh: 那位老人昨晚死于心脏病发作。

examples.en: Many birds died from the cold weather in winter.
examples.zh: 许多鸟在冬天死于寒冷的天气。

examples.en: She died of cancer at the age of fifty.
examples.zh: 她在五十岁时死于癌症。

examples.en: A group of Germans are staying at our hotel.
examples.zh: 一群德国人正住在我们的旅馆里。

examples.en: The German students visited our school yesterday.
examples.zh: 那些德国学生昨天参观了我们的学校。

examples.en: My friend is German and she teaches me German songs.
examples.zh: 我的朋友是德国人，她教我唱德国歌曲。

examples.en: Ask me again tomorrow. I need to give it some thought.
examples.zh: 明天再问我。我需要考虑一下。

examples.en: She never gives any thought to how she looks.
examples.zh: 她从不在意自己的外表。

examples.en: Tell me your thoughts on the report by Friday.
examples.zh: 周五前告诉我你对这份报告的看法。

examples.en: The sick baby only survived for a few hours.
examples.zh: 那个生病的婴儿只存活了几个小时。

examples.en: These plants can't survive in very cold weather.
examples.zh: 这些植物在非常寒冷的天气里无法存活。

examples.en: No Shakespeare play survives in its first written form.
examples.zh: 没有一部莎士比亚戏剧以最初手稿形式留存下来。

examples.en: We stopped to admire the beautiful view.
examples.zh: 我们停下来欣赏这美丽的景色。

examples.en: Delia, I really admire your jacket.
examples.zh: 迪莉娅，我真的很欣赏你的夹克。

examples.en: I admired him because he was very determined.
examples.zh: 我钦佩他，因为他很有决心。

examples.en: They showed great courage when they knew their baby had a problem.
examples.zh: 当知道宝宝有问题时，他们表现出巨大的勇气。

examples.en: People should have courage to stand up for what they believe.
examples.zh: 人们应该有勇气为自己相信的事情站出来。

examples.en: It took me months to get up the courage to ask for a better job.
examples.zh: 我花了几个月才鼓起勇气请求更好的工作。

examples.en: She ran into the forest in fear of her life.
examples.zh: 她为了逃命跑进了森林。

examples.en: The villagers lived in fear of their lives during the war.
examples.zh: 战争期间，村民们过着性命难保的生活。

examples.en: He called the police in fear of his life after the threat.
examples.zh: 收到威胁后，他因担心自己的生命安全而报了警。

examples.en: Do you like the new sofa? Yes, it's very unusual.
examples.zh: 你喜欢这张新沙发吗？是的，它很不寻常。

examples.en: It's unusual to talk with such a young child like an adult.
examples.zh: 和这么小的孩子像大人一样交谈很不寻常。

examples.en: I was on time today, which is unusual for me.
examples.zh: 我今天准时到了，这对我来说很不寻常。

examples.en: Certain chemicals can stop cells from dividing.
examples.zh: 某些化学物质可以阻止细胞分裂。

examples.en: DNA is kept in the cell's nucleus.
examples.zh: DNA储存在细胞的细胞核中。

examples.en: The baby is still just a small group of cells.
examples.zh: 这个婴儿还只是一小团细胞。

examples.en: He died because he had liver cancer.
examples.zh: 他因为得了肝癌去世了。

examples.en: Cervix cancer and stomach cancer are serious.
examples.zh: 宫颈癌和胃癌很严重。

examples.en: She is fighting breast cancer bravely.
examples.zh: 她勇敢地与乳腺癌作斗争。

examples.en: Don't tell Anne about the party. I want it to be a surprise.
examples.zh: 别告诉安妮聚会的事，我想给她一个惊喜。

examples.en: It was a nice surprise to come home and find the letter.
examples.zh: 回家发现那封信，真是个惊喜。

examples.en: Last night's heavy snow came as a big surprise.
examples.zh: 昨晚的大雪来得很突然，让人惊讶。

examples.en: The money will help medical research at universities.
examples.zh: 这笔钱将资助大学里的医学研究。

examples.en: Scientific research needs a lot of time and patience.
examples.zh: 科学研究需要很多时间和耐心。

examples.en: The student is doing research for his science report.
examples.zh: 这个学生正在为他的科学报告做研究。

examples.en: The disease kills thousands of people a year.
examples.zh: 这种疾病每年导致数千人死亡。

examples.en: Do you think there is life after death?
examples.zh: 你认为死后还有生命吗？

examples.en: He could not forget his daughter's death.
examples.zh: 他无法忘记女儿的去世。

examples.en: The weather here is pleasant and warm.
examples.zh: 这里的天气令人愉快又温暖。

examples.en: We had a pleasant day at the park.
examples.zh: 我们在公园度过了愉快的一天。

examples.en: He tried to be pleasant to the old man.
examples.zh: 他尽力对那位老人态度和蔼。

examples.en: She stars in a new 12-part drama about a woman out of prison.
examples.zh: 她主演一部新的12集电视剧，讲一个刚出狱的女人。

examples.en: Who are your favorite TV couples in comedies and dramas?
examples.zh: 在喜剧和电视剧里，你最喜欢的荧幕情侣是谁？

examples.en: The book was made into a BBC drama series.
examples.zh: 这本书被改编成了BBC的一部电视剧系列。

examples.en: She is learning photography in an evening class.
examples.zh: 她正在夜校学习摄影。

examples.en: The movie won a prize for its photography.
examples.zh: 这部电影因摄影而获奖。

examples.en: He takes photos from a plane, called aerial photography.
examples.zh: 他从飞机上拍照，这叫航空摄影。

examples.en: Painting is a popular art form in China.
examples.zh: 绘画在中国是一种受欢迎的艺术形式。

examples.en: Dance is an art form that needs much practice.
examples.zh: 舞蹈是一种需要大量练习的艺术形式。

examples.en: Making tea can be a beautiful art form.
examples.zh: 泡茶可以成为一种美丽的艺术形式。

examples.en: Do you like jazz, classical, or pop?
examples.zh: 你喜欢爵士乐、古典乐还是流行音乐？

examples.en: They play old folk music and new pop music.
examples.zh: 他们既演奏古老的民间音乐，也演奏新的流行音乐。

examples.en: They write great pop songs you can listen to again.
examples.zh: 他们写的流行歌曲很棒，你可以反复听。

examples.en: We learned to play different musical instruments in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课上学习了演奏不同的乐器。

examples.en: Mozart wrote many musical works like symphonies and operas.
examples.zh: 莫扎特写了许多音乐作品，比如交响乐和歌剧。

examples.en: Everyone in Joe's family plays an instrument. They are very musical.
examples.zh: 乔家里的每个人都会演奏一种乐器。他们很有音乐天赋。

examples.en: Her talent for music showed when she was young.
examples.zh: 她的音乐天赋在年轻时就很明显。

examples.en: His artistic talent was wasted in his boring job.
examples.zh: 他的艺术才能浪费在了无聊的工作上。

examples.en: She has great talent as a runner, so she can win with hard training.
examples.zh: 她很有跑步天赋，所以刻苦训练就能赢。

examples.en: The Ural mountains are the boundary between Europe and Asia.
examples.zh: 乌拉尔山脉是欧洲和亚洲之间的边界。

examples.en: People don't want the prison inside the city boundary.
examples.zh: 人们不希望监狱建在城市边界内。

examples.en: E-publishing is blurring the boundary between dictionaries and encyclopedias.
examples.zh: 电子出版正在模糊词典和百科全书之间的界限。

examples.en: She got a medal for helping people in the war.
examples.zh: 她因为在战争中帮助别人而获得了一枚奖牌。

examples.en: He was given a medal because he was very brave.
examples.zh: 他因为非常勇敢而被授予了一枚奖牌。

examples.en: She won three gold medals in the Olympics.
examples.zh: 她在奥运会上赢得了三枚金牌。

examples.en: The teacher presented the prize to the winner.
examples.zh: 老师把奖品颁发给了获胜者。

examples.en: They presented the tickets to me as a gift.
examples.zh: 他们把票作为礼物送给了我。

examples.en: My sister presented the coat to me for my birthday.
examples.zh: 我姐姐把外套作为生日礼物送给了我。

examples.en: The winner will get a prize.
examples.zh: 获胜者将得到一份奖品。

examples.en: The match winner will play Aston Villa.
examples.zh: 这场比赛的获胜者将对阵阿斯顿维拉队。

examples.en: Samantha will pick the lucky winners from the bag.
examples.zh: 萨曼莎将从袋子里抽出幸运的获胜者。

examples.en: A composer named Strauss was once asked to fight a duel.
examples.zh: 一位名叫施特劳斯的作曲家曾被要求参加决斗。

examples.en: Duke Ellington was a famous jazz composer and pianist.
examples.zh: 杜克·艾灵顿是一位著名的爵士乐作曲家和钢琴家。

examples.en: As a composer, he was as good as the best ones.
examples.zh: 作为作曲家，他和最优秀的人一样出色。

examples.en: Central Europe is colder than the south in winter.
examples.zh: 中欧冬天比南方更冷。

examples.en: A shop with a central location costs more to rent.
examples.zh: 位置在市中心店铺的租金更贵。

examples.en: A bomb went off in central London just now.
examples.zh: 刚刚伦敦市中心发生了一起爆炸。

examples.en: Guitars, pianos, and cellos are kinds of string instruments.
examples.zh: 吉他、钢琴和大提琴是弦乐器的种类。

examples.en: A violin is a stringed instrument with four strings.
examples.zh: 小提琴是一种有四根弦的弦乐器。

examples.en: A piano is a popular keyboard instrument for students.
examples.zh: 钢琴是一种受学生欢迎的键盘乐器。

examples.en: It is common to see couples wear the same clothes.
examples.zh: 看到情侣穿一样的衣服很常见。

examples.en: Smith is a very common name in Britain.
examples.zh: 史密斯在英国是一个非常常见的名字。

examples.en: Working at home is now common for many people.
examples.zh: 在家工作现在对许多人来说很常见。

examples.en: A stone is a solid object.
examples.zh: 石头是固体物品。

examples.en: He has a collection of precious objects.
examples.zh: 他收藏了一批珍贵的物品。

examples.en: A strange object was seen in the sky.
examples.zh: 有人看到天空中有一个奇怪的物体。

examples.en: We built a stone wall in our garden.
examples.zh: 我们在花园里建了一堵石头墙。

examples.en: There is a flight of stone steps to the door.
examples.zh: 有一段石阶通向门口。

examples.en: The man used a stone axe to cut wood.
examples.zh: 那个人用石斧劈木头。

examples.en: The concert has musicians and dancers from many countries.
examples.zh: 这场音乐会有来自许多国家的音乐家和舞蹈家。

examples.en: I am not a real musician, but I like to play music for fun.
examples.zh: 我不是真正的音乐家，但我喜欢玩音乐取乐。

examples.en: Duke Ellington was a great jazz musician, composer and pianist.
examples.zh: 杜克·艾灵顿是一位伟大的爵士音乐家、作曲家和钢琴家。

examples.en: China is famous for the Great Wall.
examples.zh: 中国因长城而著名。

examples.en: This city is known for its beautiful parks.
examples.zh: 这座城市因其美丽的公园而闻名。

examples.en: She is famous for singing English songs.
examples.zh: 她因唱英文歌而出名。

examples.en: If you can't control your dog, keep it on a rope.
examples.zh: 如果你控制不了你的狗，就把它拴在绳子上。

examples.en: You must learn to control your anger.
examples.zh: 你必须学会控制你的怒气。

examples.en: The temperature is controlled by a machine.
examples.zh: 温度是由一台机器控制的。

examples.en: Lava was flowing down the hill slowly.
examples.zh: 熔岩正缓慢地流下山坡。

examples.en: Many small rivers flow into the Pacific.
examples.zh: 许多小河汇入太平洋。

examples.en: The river flows through three towns to the sea.
examples.zh: 这条河流经三个城镇后入海。

examples.en: Many patients were successfully treated with the new drug.
examples.zh: 许多病人用新药成功地得到了治疗。

examples.en: The book successfully shows the horror of war.
examples.zh: 这本书成功地展现了战争的恐怖。

examples.en: He successfully balances family life and his job.
examples.zh: 他成功地平衡了家庭生活和工作。

examples.en: People in the village still keep their traditional customs.
examples.zh: 村里的人仍然保留着他们的传统习俗。

examples.en: The school teaches reading with both modern and traditional ways.
examples.zh: 学校用现代和传统两种方式教阅读。

examples.en: The dancers wore traditional Hungarian clothes.
examples.zh: 舞者们穿着传统的匈牙利服装。

examples.en: I stood at the door and rang the bell twice.
examples.zh: 我站在门口，按了两次铃。

examples.en: The church bell rang in the town square.
examples.zh: 教堂的钟声在城镇广场响起。

examples.en: The bells rang out for the new year.
examples.zh: 钟声响起迎接新年。

examples.en: She hasn't called, though she said she would.
examples.zh: 她还没有打电话，尽管她说过会打的。

examples.en: They're coming next week, though I don't know the day.
examples.zh: 他们下周来，虽然我不知道是哪一天。

examples.en: You look as though you ran a marathon!
examples.zh: 你看起来好像跑了马拉松一样！

examples.en: This path is the dividing line between my land and my neighbor's.
examples.zh: 这条小路是我和我邻居土地的分界线。

examples.en: For many TV watchers, the dividing line between fact and fiction is unclear now.
examples.zh: 对许多电视观众来说，事实和虚构的界限现在不清楚了。

examples.en: Public spending was the main dividing line in the last election.
examples.zh: 公共开支是上次选举的主要分界线。

examples.en: She got a highly paid job in a bank.
examples.zh: 她得到了一份银行里的高薪工作。

examples.en: These products bring highly good profits.
examples.zh: 这些产品带来非常高的利润。

examples.en: Our country needs highly skilled and educated workers.
examples.zh: 我们的国家需要高技能、高学历的工人。

examples.en: He ran into the room, red-faced and out of breath.
examples.zh: 他跑进房间，脸红红的，上气不接下气。

examples.en: She felt dizzy and was short of breath.
examples.zh: 她感到头晕，并且气短。

examples.en: Her breath smelled of garlic.
examples.zh: 她的呼吸里有大蒜味。

examples.en: After running to school, I was out of breath.
examples.zh: 跑到学校后，我上气不接下气。

examples.en: She climbed the stairs and felt out of breath.
examples.zh: 她爬了楼梯，感到上气不接下气。

examples.en: He talked so fast that he was out of breath.
examples.zh: 他说得太快，以致于上气不接下气。

examples.en: I hate to be the last person to get to a meeting.
examples.zh: 我讨厌开会时最后一个到。

examples.en: He was the last person to see the woman, so people suspected him.
examples.zh: 他是最后一个见到那个女士的人，所以人们怀疑他。

examples.en: Our house is the last one on the left before the lights.
examples.zh: 我们的房子是红绿灯前左边最后一栋。

examples.en: We enjoyed a pop concert last night.
examples.zh: 我们昨晚欣赏了一场流行音乐会。

examples.en: Our school will hold a concert next month.
examples.zh: 我们学校下个月将举办一场音乐会。

examples.en: I will play at a concert in the church hall this weekend.
examples.zh: 这周末我将在教堂大厅的音乐会上演奏。

examples.en: Ordinary folk can't buy such cars.
examples.zh: 普通老百姓买不起这样的汽车。

examples.zh: 这两个国家就像经济上的双胞胎。

examples.en: You were brave to run after the burglar.
examples.zh: 你追那个入室窃贼，真是勇敢。

examples.zh: 没有家庭安全工具能阻止一个认真的入室窃贼。

examples.zh: 那个入室窃贼在窗户上留下了指纹。

examples.zh: 我们能听到远处开枪的声音。

examples.zh: 英国警察不携带枪支。

examples.zh: 他学会了如何安全地使用枪。

examples.zh: 他年纪轻轻就成了摇滚超级明星。

examples.zh: 她梦想成为像泰勒·斯威夫特那样的超级明星。

examples.zh: 粉丝们远道而来观看体育超级明星比赛。

examples.zh: 你觉得你能打败我？你做梦！

examples.zh: 他想赢这场比赛，但那只是妄想。

examples.zh: 她说她会得A，但你那是做梦。

examples.zh: 这个箱子太重了，以至于我搬不动它。

examples.zh: 她太累了，以至于很快就睡着了。

examples.zh: 他说话太快了，以至于没人能听懂他。

examples.zh: 我上周末看了一部激动人心的动作片。

examples.zh: 我爸爸喜欢有汽车追逐场面的动作片。

examples.zh: 那部动作片太酷了，我们看了两遍。

examples.zh: 我喜欢在晚上读一本浪漫小说。

examples.zh: 这部电影是浪漫喜剧，以婚礼结尾。

examples.zh: 你以前很浪漫，但现在你从不说你爱我。

examples.zh: 我喜欢在空闲时间读科幻故事。

examples.zh: 这部科幻电影非常刺激，也很受欢迎。

examples.zh: 她为她的班级写了一篇短篇科幻故事。

examples.zh: 这个城市的西部非常安静。

examples.zh: 在19世纪，许多人搬到了美国西部。

examples.zh: 贸易和工业帮助城市发展。

examples.zh: 工业和商业带来许多工作机会。

examples.zh: 这座城市需要更多工业来创造就业机会。

examples.zh: 这个箱子如此重，以至于我搬不动它。

examples.zh: 她发出那么大的声音，以至于把婴儿吵醒了。

examples.en: It was such a hot day that we stayed at home.
examples.zh: 那天如此热，以至于我们待在了家里。

examples.en: My grandma told stories very well.
examples.zh: 我奶奶故事讲得非常好。

examples.en: Your imagination can help you be a good storyteller.
examples.zh: 你的想象力能帮你成为好的讲故事的人。

examples.zh: 爱尔兰有一位伟大的讲故事的人，叫罗迪·多伊尔。

examples.zh: 布鲁斯·罗宾逊为这部电影写了剧本。

examples.zh: 这个乐队为舞台上的行为写了一本“剧本”。

examples.zh: 地球没有按照科学家写的“剧本”走。

examples.en: The lake water hit an all-time low after three dry years.
examples.zh: 经过三年干旱，湖水水位降到了空前最低点。

examples.en: In October, the stock price reached an all-time high of $90.
examples.zh: 十月，股价达到了90美元的历史最高点。

examples.zh: 今年，我们学校在运动会上创造了空前纪录。

examples.zh: 她是好莱坞收入最高的女演员。

examples.zh: 他是著名男演员，她也是女演员。

examples.zh: 看看今年最佳女主角奖的女演员们。

examples.zh: 当孩子离开家时，父母会感到失落。

examples.zh: 他慢慢失去了记忆，这对他来说是个可怕的损失。

examples.zh: 如果工厂关闭，许多工人将面临失业。

examples.zh: 那个囚犯因为人道主义原因被释放了。

examples.zh: 联合国正在向受战争影响的地区提供人道主义援助。

examples.en: Joseph Rowntree, a famous humanitarian, cared about his workers.
examples.zh: 约瑟夫·朗特里，一位著名的人道主义者，关心他的工人。

examples.zh: 她想成为一名芭蕾舞演员。

examples.zh: 他15岁时写了第一部芭蕾舞曲。

examples.zh: 她学古典芭蕾还是现代芭蕾？

examples.zh: 他是皇家芭蕾舞团的一名舞蹈者。

examples.zh: 我不知道你舞跳得这么好。

examples.zh: 她受过古典训练，成为了一名舞蹈者。

examples.en: She is a woman of great charm.
examples.zh: 她是一位很有魅力的女士。

examples.en: The town has a lot of old-world charm.
examples.zh: 这座小镇有很多古典魅力。

examples.en: He turned on the charm to get what he wanted.
examples.zh: 他施展魅力来得到他想要的东西。

examples.en: The bright colors caught my attention in the store.
examples.zh: 商店里鲜艳的颜色吸引了我的注意。

examples.en: Her loud voice caught everyone's attention in class.
examples.zh: 她响亮的嗓音在课堂上吸引了所有人的注意。

examples.en: A sudden noise caught his attention while he was reading.
examples.zh: 他读书时，突然的响声吸引了他的注意。

examples.en: Greg still insists that he did nothing wrong.
examples.zh: 格雷格仍然坚持认为他没做错任何事。

examples.en: Please go first — I insist!
examples.zh: 请先走——我坚持这样！

examples.en: She insisted on seeing her lawyer.
examples.zh: 她坚持要见她的律师。

examples.en: What is his role in this project?
examples.zh: 他在这个项目中的角色是什么？

examples.en: Schools play an important role in society.
examples.zh: 学校在社会中扮演重要角色。

examples.en: Six people were on trial for their role in the protests.
examples.zh: 六个人因在抗议中的角色而受审。

examples.en: The glass has a heavy base.
examples.zh: 这个玻璃杯有一个很重的底座。

examples.en: There is a rocky beach at the base of the cliff.
examples.zh: 悬崖底部有一片岩石海滩。

examples.en: This cream is a good base for your make-up.
examples.zh: 这瓶面霜是你化妆的好底霜。

examples.en: Her major plays are now in English.
examples.zh: 她的主要戏剧现在有英文版了。

examples.en: Sugar is a major reason for tooth decay.
examples.zh: 糖是蛀牙的一个主要原因。

examples.en: This situation has two problems: one major, one minor.
examples.zh: 这种情况有两个问题：一个大的，一个小的。

examples.en: Moving up the career ladder takes hard work.
examples.zh: 在职业阶梯上往上爬需要努力工作。

examples.en: I chose this job for better career prospects.
examples.zh: 我选择这份工作是为了更好的职业前景。

examples.en: He wants a career as a police officer.
examples.zh: 他想当警察，把警察当作自己的职业。

examples.en: She plays the role of a doctor in the school play.
examples.zh: 她在学校戏剧中扮演医生的角色。

examples.en: He played the role of a hero to save the little girl.
examples.zh: 他扮演英雄的角色去救那个小女孩。

examples.en: Our teacher will play the role of the judge in the game.
examples.zh: 我们的老师将在游戏中扮演裁判的角色。

examples.en: Diana Spencer became a princess when she married Charles.
examples.zh: 戴安娜·斯宾塞嫁给查尔斯后成为了王妃。

examples.en: The prince and the princess married and lived happily.
examples.zh: 王子和公主结婚了，幸福地生活着。

examples.en: The princess in the story had long, soft hair.
examples.zh: 故事里的公主有一头又长又软的头发。

examples.en: We will see many great technology changes in our lifetime.
examples.zh: 在我们的一生中，我们会看到许多巨大的科技变化。

examples.en: I never thought such a thing could happen during my lifetime.
examples.zh: 我从没想过这种事会发生在我的一生中。

examples.en: The winner will enjoy the holiday of a lifetime.
examples.zh: 获胜者将享受一生中最棒的假期。

examples.en: Two nominations for the new job have come in.
examples.zh: 这份新工作已经收到了两项提名。

examples.en: May I make a nomination? Keep your receipts for tax back.
examples.zh: 我可以提个名吗？留着收据以便退税。

examples.en: The nomination for the new stadium was rejected.
examples.zh: 新体育馆的提名被拒绝了。

examples.en: This is my final warning to you.
examples.zh: 这是我对你的最后一次警告。

examples.en: I read the final chapter of the book.
examples.zh: 我读了这本书的最后一章。

examples.en: These are the final years of his life.
examples.zh: 这是他生命最后的几年。

examples.en: His first appearance on TV was as president.
examples.zh: 他第一次在电视上露面是作为总统。

examples.en: She will make a public appearance to sign her new book.
examples.zh: 她将公开露面，签售她的新书。

examples.en: This was the man's third court appearance for the same crime.
examples.zh: 这是该男子因同一罪行第三次出庭。

examples.zh: 在《圣经》里，一位天使告诉玛丽她将生下耶稣。

examples.en: Be an angel and help me with this, please.
examples.zh: 行行好，请帮我做这个。

examples.en: Our kids are usually quiet, not little angels.
examples.zh: 我们的孩子通常很安静，不是小天使。

examples.en: Beyond the river, there was a small town.
examples.zh: 河的那边，有一个小镇。

examples.en: From the hill, we saw our house and the woods beyond.
examples.zh: 从山上，我们看到了我们的房子和远处的树林。

examples.en: The path goes beyond the end of the road.
examples.zh: 这条小路延伸到了路的尽头之外。

examples.en: If we all make an effort to keep the office tidy, it helps.
examples.zh: 如果我们都努力保持办公室整洁，那会有帮助。

examples.en: You won't have friends if you don't make an effort with people.
examples.zh: 如果你不努力与人交往，就不会有朋友。

examples.en: The government made an effort to reduce crime and hired more police.
examples.zh: 政府努力减少犯罪，雇了更多警察。

examples.en: My grandpa passed away last year, and I miss him very much.
examples.zh: 我爷爷去年去世了，我非常想念他。

examples.en: The old man passed away peacefully in his sleep.
examples.zh: 那位老人在睡梦中安详地去世了。

examples.zh: 她的猫病了很久之后去世了。

examples.en: I hope we can solve the problem peacefully.
examples.zh: 我希望我们能和平地解决这个问题。

examples.en: The protest ended peacefully, and only two people were arrested.
examples.zh: 抗议和平结束，只有两个人被捕。

examples.en: The music festival went on peacefully, though people worried about it.
examples.zh: 音乐节和平地进行，尽管人们曾担心它。

examples.zh: 她是一位漂亮的年轻女士。

examples.en: I find him very attractive.
examples.zh: 我觉得他很有吸引力。

examples.zh: 那里的乡村景色非常迷人。

examples.zh: 交通高峰期堵车让我上学迟到。

examples.en: Please take another way during the morning rush hour.
examples.zh: 早高峰时请走另一条路。

examples.en: It takes twice as long to drive to work during rush hour.
examples.zh: 在交通高峰期开车上班要多花两倍的时间。

examples.en: We parked our car near the park.
examples.zh: 我们把车停在公园附近。

examples.zh: 不要在公园的草地上停车。

examples.zh: 她把自行车停在公园门口。

examples.en: I parked my car in the car park.
examples.zh: 我把车停在停车场里。

examples.zh: 我们把那块地变成了停车场。

examples.zh: 城里的停车场收费很贵。

examples.zh: 我们在学校后面种了一排树。

examples.zh: 六十个人来了，坐满了七排座位。

examples.zh: 汽车排成一排，面朝大海停着。

examples.zh: 事故后她感到平静，这让她很惊奇。

examples.zh: 听说他得到了新工作，我很惊奇。

examples.zh: 格雷厄姆先生惊奇地在罐子里发现了46枚古金币。

examples.zh: 别怪自己，我们都会犯错。

examples.en: It was a mistake to come here tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚来这里是个错误。

examples.en: This letter has many spelling mistakes.
examples.zh: 这封信里有很多拼写错误。

examples.zh: 我经常把他误认为他的双胞胎兄弟。

examples.en: She mistook the rope for a snake.
examples.zh: 她把绳子误认为蛇了。

examples.en: Don't mistake my kindness for weakness.
examples.zh: 别把我的善良误认为软弱。

examples.zh: 他喜欢每天早上练习功夫。

examples.zh: 我叔叔可以给你展示一些功夫动作。

examples.zh: 她跟一位著名的师傅学了功夫。

examples.zh: 我圣诞节得到了一张《欢乐满人间》的DVD。

examples.en: Is this movie on DVD?
examples.zh: 这部电影有DVD版本吗？

examples.en: My computer has a DVD player.
examples.zh: 我的电脑有DVD播放器。

examples.zh: 谁是你最喜欢的演员？罗伯特·德尼罗。

examples.zh: 她是当今最好的演员之一。

examples.zh: 他是一位著名的好莱坞演员。

examples.zh: 他给我们讲了一些关于他在印度生活的有趣故事。

examples.zh: 她编了一个错过公交的故事来解释迟到。

examples.zh: 这本书是一个给孩子们读的童话故事。

examples.zh: 他发现并收集了一些恐龙骨骼和牙齿的化石。

examples.zh: 这台电脑太老旧了，不是吗？

examples.zh: 那辆旧车是个大块头，所以我们把它卖掉了。

examples.zh: 他对她一见钟情。

examples.zh: 认识他一年后，她爱上了他。

examples.zh: 许多人在高中时爱上某人。

examples.zh: 你仍然可以享受355美元的往返航班特价优惠。

examples.zh: 这项特价优惠让商务客户在酒店多住一晚。

examples.en: Don't miss the special offer for cheap flight tickets.
examples.zh: 不要错过便宜机票的特价优惠。

examples.zh: 因为下雨，他们不得不取消比赛。

examples.zh: 去布达佩斯的7点10分的火车被取消了。

examples.zh: 她想取消她的杂志订阅。

examples.zh: 她辞掉工作很愚蠢。

examples.zh: 晚上开车是谁的蠢主意？

examples.zh: 他觉得早退休很愚蠢。

examples.zh: 特技替身演员在电影中为演员完成危险动作。

examples.zh: 特技替身演员安全地从高楼跳下。

examples.zh: 我叔叔在好莱坞电影里当特技替身演员。

examples.zh: 在你考虑情况之前，要仔细想清楚。

examples.zh: 你考虑过没得到这份工作该怎么办吗？

examples.zh: 我们正在考虑卖掉我们的房子。

examples.zh: 我叔叔是一名私家侦探。

examples.en: I like reading detective stories.
examples.zh: 我喜欢读侦探故事。

examples.zh: 刘易斯警探抓住了小偷。

examples.zh: 警察仍在寻找线索来找到那个失踪的女孩。

examples.zh: 如果你不给我一条线索，我猜不出答案。

examples.zh: 警察在女孩家附近的树林里找到了一条线索。

examples.zh: 她的父亲从1992年起就失踪了。

examples.zh: 那个女孩在一次家庭旅行中失踪了。

examples.zh: 警察昨天报告那个男孩失踪了。

examples.zh: 到目前为止，警方没有怀疑有任何犯罪行为。

examples.zh: 我们没有理由怀疑他会伤害自己。

examples.zh: 我怀疑她已经告诉了他们，但我不确定。
