examples.zh: 她是一个中等身高的女孩。

examples.en: I read a medium-sized book yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天读了一本中等大小的书。

examples.en: My hairdryer has high, medium and low settings.
examples.zh: 我的吹风机有高、中、低三档。

examples.en: I looked at her untidy room and didn't know what to do.
examples.zh: 我看着她不整洁的房间，不知道该怎么办。

examples.en: Tom's clothes are always in an untidy pile on the floor.
examples.zh: 汤姆的衣服总是乱糟糟地堆在地上。

examples.en: The small tables in the room have untidy piles of papers.
examples.zh: 房间的小桌子上有一堆堆不整洁的纸张。

examples.en: I feel guilty because I didn't help him.
examples.zh: 我感到内疚，因为我没有帮助他。

examples.en: He feels guilty about losing his friend's book.
examples.zh: 他为弄丢朋友的书感到内疚。

examples.en: She looks guilty, so she must have lied.
examples.zh: 她看起来很心虚，所以一定撒了谎。

examples.en: There is some truth in what she says.
examples.zh: 她说的话有些道理。

examples.en: There is no truth in the reports about his leaving.
examples.zh: 关于他离职的报道不属实。

examples.en: You cannot question the truth of his story.
examples.zh: 你不能怀疑他所说事情的真实性。

examples.en: I didn't know the answer, so I guessed.
examples.zh: 我不知道答案，所以我就猜了。

examples.en: If they guess wrong, they may lose much money.
examples.zh: 如果他们猜错了，他们可能会损失很多钱。

examples.en: She guessed right on the last question.
examples.zh: 她最后一个问题猜对了。

examples.en: He likes to lie in bed on Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 他喜欢周日早上躺在床上。

examples.en: She wants to lie on a beach this summer.
examples.zh: 她今年夏天想躺在海滩上。

examples.en: Please lie on your side for the check.
examples.zh: 请侧躺以便检查。

examples.en: Six people confirmed they will come, and ten haven't replied yet.
examples.zh: 六个人确认会来，还有十个人没回复。

examples.en: You should confirm your flight 48 hours before leaving.
examples.zh: 你应该在出发前48小时确认航班。

examples.en: I said yes on the phone, but I haven't confirmed it in writing.
examples.zh: 我在电话里答应了，但还没书面确认。

examples.en: We should give money to help hurricane victims.
examples.zh: 我们应该捐钱帮助飓风受害者。

examples.en: The police try to protect crime victims.
examples.zh: 警察努力保护犯罪受害者。

examples.en: Children are the innocent victims of the war.
examples.zh: 儿童是战争的无辜受害者。

examples.en: She said she would fight crime and change the government.
examples.zh: 她说她会打击犯罪并改变政府。

examples.en: The rate of violent crime went down last month.
examples.zh: 上个月暴力犯罪率下降了。

examples.en: The government will add more police to stop serious crime.
examples.zh: 政府将增加更多警察来制止严重犯罪。

examples.en: He was last heard living somewhere in the south of France.
examples.zh: 最后听说他住在法国南部某处。

examples.en: You must have put their letter somewhere!
examples.zh: 你一定把他们的信放在某个地方了！

examples.en: I'm looking for somewhere to eat.
examples.zh: 我正在找地方吃饭。

examples.en: Have you been in contact with Andrew? Only by phone.
examples.zh: 你和安德鲁联系过吗？只通过电话。

examples.en: I'm still in contact with her. We write twice a year.
examples.zh: 我和她还有联系。我们一年写两次信。

examples.en: There isn't enough contact between teachers and parents.
examples.zh: 老师和家长之间的接触不够。

examples.en: He got a gunshot wound in his arm.
examples.zh: 他手臂上有一处枪伤。

examples.en: The doctor cleaned the wound on his leg.
examples.zh: 医生清理了他腿上的伤口。

examples.en: Don't worry, it's just a flesh wound.
examples.zh: 别担心，这只是皮外伤。

examples.en: Your arm is bleeding. Please see a doctor.
examples.zh: 你的手臂在流血。请去看医生。

examples.en: He was bleeding a lot after the fall.
examples.zh: 他摔倒后流了很多血。

examples.en: Don't use wet ink, or the colors will bleed together.
examples.zh: 别用湿墨水，否则颜色会混在一起。

examples.en: He made an enemy in his company.
examples.zh: 他在公司里树了一个敌人。

examples.en: Max stole Lee's girl, so they became enemies.
examples.zh: 麦克斯抢了李的女友，所以他们成了敌人。

examples.en: The two men are political enemies.
examples.zh: 这两个人是政治上的敌人。

examples.en: He hit the man down with a single blow.
examples.zh: 他一拳就把那个人打倒了。

examples.en: Not a single person came to help her.
examples.zh: 没有一个人来帮她。

examples.en: You didn't listen to a single word I said.
examples.zh: 我说的话你一个字都没听。

examples.en: She was not well-paid and couldn't support her family.
examples.zh: 她收入不高，无法养家。

examples.en: He finally got a well-paid job he liked.
examples.zh: 他终于找到了一份喜欢且收入高的工作。

examples.en: Only well-paid people can buy homes there.
examples.zh: 只有高收入的人才能在那里买房。

examples.en: The local museum doesn't charge for entry.
examples.zh: 当地博物馆不收费入场。

examples.en: How much do you charge for a haircut?
examples.zh: 你理一次发收费多少？

examples.en: Can I charge the company for the petrol I use?
examples.zh: 我能让公司为我用的汽油付费吗？

examples.en: Someone broke into my house last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚有人闯进了我的房子。

examples.en: The thief tried to break into the shop.
examples.zh: 那个小偷试图闯入商店。

examples.en: Don't break into my room without asking.
examples.zh: 未经允许不要闯进我的房间。

examples.en: Our school has a new sound system.
examples.zh: 我们学校有一套新的音响系统。

examples.en: The system often stops working and we don't know why.
examples.zh: 这个系统经常停止工作，我们不知道原因。

examples.en: The body's immune system helps keep us healthy.
examples.zh: 身体的免疫系统帮助我们保持健康。

examples.en: Dan didn't answer his phone, so I suppose he is busy.
examples.zh: 丹没接电话，所以我猜想他很忙。

examples.en: He found it harder to get a job than he supposed.
examples.zh: 他发现找工作比他原来料想的更难。

examples.en: Do you suppose Gillian will marry him?
examples.zh: 你猜想吉莉安会嫁给他吗？

examples.en: I was the only one on the train.
examples.zh: 我是火车上唯一的人。

examples.en: Is this the only way to do it?
examples.zh: 这是做这件事的唯一方法吗？

examples.en: The only thing that matters is the baby is healthy.
examples.zh: 唯一重要的是宝宝健康。

examples.en: A witness said two teenagers did the robbery.
examples.zh: 一位目击者说抢劫是两个青少年干的。

examples.en: Police ask witnesses of the accident to come forward.
examples.zh: 警方请事故的目击者站出来作证。

examples.en: She was a witness to the sad event.
examples.zh: 她是这个悲惨事件的目击者。

examples.en: We called the insurance company to report the theft.
examples.zh: 我们打电话给保险公司报告了盗窃案。

examples.en: All the newspapers reported the killing of the leader.
examples.zh: 所有报纸都报道了领袖被杀的事。

examples.en: He reported on the company's money situation.
examples.zh: 他报告了公司的财务状况。

examples.en: The doctor told me to breathe in and stop for three seconds.
examples.zh: 医生让我吸气并停三秒钟。

examples.en: Breathing in a little gas can hurt you badly.
examples.zh: 吸入一点气体就可能严重伤害你。

examples.en: The teacher said to take a deep breath and breathe out slowly.
examples.zh: 老师说先深呼吸，然后慢慢呼气。

examples.en: The soldiers are heavily armed with guns.
examples.zh: 士兵们携带很多武器。

examples.en: The building is heavily guarded by police.
examples.zh: 这栋楼有很多警察严密看守。

examples.en: She is heavily involved in our school project.
examples.zh: 她深深地参与了我们学校的项目。

examples.en: There is a reward for the first one to finish.
examples.zh: 第一个完成的人会得到报酬。

examples.en: The rewards of being a mother are greater than the pain.
examples.zh: 当母亲的回报大于痛苦。

examples.en: A good reward system helps bosses get what they want from workers.
examples.zh: 好的奖励制度能帮助老板从员工那里得到他们想要的。

examples.en: He was arrested when the police found drugs in his bag.
examples.zh: 警察在他包里发现毒品时，他被捕了。

examples.en: The police arrested her for drinking and driving.
examples.zh: 警察因她酒后开车而逮捕了她。

examples.en: The police arrested them for smuggling cigarettes.
examples.zh: 警察因他们走私香烟而逮捕了他们。

examples.en: The doctor said my leg will be fine in a couple of days.
examples.zh: 医生说过我的腿过几天就会好的。

examples.en: A couple of people said no, but most said yes.
examples.zh: 有几个人反对，但大多数人都同意了。

examples.en: We must wait another couple of hours for the paint to dry.
examples.zh: 我们必须再等几个小时让油漆干。

examples.en: His fingerprints were all over the gun.
examples.zh: 枪上到处都是他的指纹。

examples.en: The police took fingerprints from every man here.
examples.zh: 警察取了这里每个人的指纹。

examples.en: We want to fingerprint all your workers.
examples.zh: 我们想给你们所有的员工录指纹。

examples.en: I will probably get home before midnight.
examples.zh: 我大概会在午夜前到家。

examples.en: I will probably go, but it depends on the weather.
examples.zh: 我或许会去，但这取决于天气。

examples.en: He probably didn't even see it.
examples.zh: 他大概甚至没看见它。

examples.en: He is a dangerous criminal.
examples.zh: 他是一个危险的罪犯。

examples.en: A problem child may become a criminal.
examples.zh: 问题儿童可能会变成罪犯。

examples.en: The policeman told the criminal to keep quiet.
examples.zh: 警察告诉罪犯保持安静。

examples.en: She was chosen as the best female singer.
examples.zh: 她被选为最佳女歌手。

examples.en: She was the school's first trans female player.
examples.zh: 她是学校第一位跨性别女运动员。

examples.en: His show usually drew mostly female viewers.
examples.zh: 他的节目通常吸引大多数女性观众。

examples.en: She was the boss of a big company.
examples.zh: 她是一家大公司的老板。

examples.en: I started my own business and now I'm my own boss.
examples.zh: 我创办了自己的公司，现在我是自己的老板。

examples.en: Who is the boss in your family?
examples.zh: 你们家谁说了算？

examples.en: He went to prison for a crime he didn't commit.
examples.zh: 他因一项他没犯的罪进了监狱。

examples.en: He committed a murder and ran away.
examples.zh: 他犯了谋杀罪并且逃跑了。

examples.en: She committed an offence and said sorry.
examples.zh: 她犯了错并道了歉。

examples.en: The party turned out to be a big success.
examples.zh: 派对结果非常成功。

examples.en: It turned out that he was my old friend.
examples.zh: 原来他是我的老朋友。

examples.en: The weather turned out fine after the rain.
examples.zh: 雨后天气结果变晴了。

examples.en: This problem has nothing to do with me.
examples.zh: 这个问题与我无关。

examples.en: Her success has nothing to do with luck.
examples.zh: 她的成功与运气无关。

examples.en: I have nothing to do with that broken window.
examples.zh: 我和那扇破窗户无关。

examples.en: Hurry, or you will be late for school.
examples.zh: 快点，否则你上学要迟到了。

examples.en: She hurried to answer the phone call.
examples.zh: 她匆忙去接电话。

examples.en: Don't hurry me into making a choice.
examples.zh: 别催我匆忙做决定。

examples.en: She was in a hurry and forgot her keys.
examples.zh: 她匆匆忙忙，忘了带钥匙。

examples.en: Don't eat in a hurry, or you may get a stomachache.
examples.zh: 别急着吃，否则可能会胃疼。

examples.en: He ran to school in a hurry this morning.
examples.zh: 他今天早上急匆匆地跑去了学校。

examples.en: The police stopped the kidnapping of the rich man's son.
examples.zh: 警察阻止了富家儿子的绑架案。

examples.en: She read a story about a kidnapping on the train.
examples.zh: 她读了一个关于火车上绑架案的故事。

examples.en: Anyone involved in kidnapping will be sent to prison.
examples.zh: 任何参与绑架的人都会被送进监狱。

examples.en: She made a lot of wealth in her business career.
examples.zh: 她在商业生涯中积累了大量财富。

examples.en: Poverty and wealth both exist in this city.
examples.zh: 贫穷和财富都存在于这座城市。

examples.en: Their policies all aim to create wealth.
examples.zh: 他们的政策都是为了创造财富。

examples.en: The prison conditions are very bad, they say.
examples.zh: 他们说监狱条件很差。

examples.en: It was a prison that is very hard to escape from.
examples.zh: 那是一座很难逃出来的监狱。

examples.en: He was sent to a federal prison last year.
examples.zh: 他去年被送进了一座联邦监狱。

examples.en: The thief was in prison for two years.
examples.zh: 那个小偷坐牢两年了。

examples.en: He is in prison because he stole a car.
examples.zh: 他因为偷车而坐牢。

examples.en: My uncle once put a bad man in prison.
examples.zh: 我叔叔曾经把一个坏人送进监狱。

examples.en: A businessman's wife was kidnapped at home last night.
examples.zh: 一位商人的妻子昨晚在家中遭绑架。

examples.en: I must take my mom to the doctor today, not kidnap her.
examples.zh: 我今天必须带妈妈去看医生，不是绑架她。

examples.en: I said I would go with him to the police station, not kidnap him.
examples.zh: 我说过我会和他一起去警察局，不是绑架他。

examples.en: For your safety, please keep your seat belt loose during the flight.
examples.zh: 为了您的安全，飞行期间请将安全带松着系好。

examples.en: Reporters can enter the danger zone, but we can't assure their safety.
examples.zh: 记者可以进入危险区域，但我们无法保证他们的安全。

examples.en: The ship's crew were lifted to safety by a rescue helicopter.
examples.zh: 船上的船员被救援直升机吊到安全的地方。

examples.en: I heard someone turn a key in the lock.
examples.zh: 我听见有人用钥匙开锁。

examples.en: These safety locks keep the door strong.
examples.zh: 这些安全锁让门更牢固。

examples.en: Thieves broke the lock and got in.
examples.zh: 小偷弄坏锁闯了进来。

examples.en: Please shut the gate.
examples.zh: 请关上大门。

examples.en: Shut your eyes tightly and give me your hand.
examples.zh: 紧紧闭上眼睛，把手给我。

examples.en: Mary shut her book and put it on the table.
examples.zh: 玛丽合上书，把它放在桌上。

examples.en: The prison guards stopped over 50 prisoners from escaping.
examples.zh: 监狱守卫阻止了50多名囚犯逃跑。

examples.en: Armed guards stand around the site.
examples.zh: 武装守卫站在场地周围。

examples.en: Border guards patrol the frontier.
examples.zh: 边境守卫在边界巡逻。

examples.en: You should guard against catching a cold in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天你应该防范感冒。

examples.en: We must guard against making the same mistake again.
examples.zh: 我们必须提防再犯同样的错误。

examples.en: She guards against spending too much money on clothes.
examples.zh: 她提防在衣服上花太多钱。

examples.en: She wore a gold necklace to the party.
examples.zh: 她戴着一条金项链去参加聚会。

examples.en: The silver necklace is a gift from my mom.
examples.zh: 这条银项链是我妈妈送的礼物。

examples.en: Her pearl necklace looks very beautiful.
examples.zh: 她的珍珠项链看起来很漂亮。

examples.en: Sadly, we had some thefts in our building lately.
examples.zh: 遗憾的是，我们楼里最近发生了几起偷窃。

examples.en: Taking things from a store is theft.
examples.zh: 从商店拿东西不付钱就是偷窃。

examples.en: He planned to do a theft in a second.
examples.zh: 他打算马上实施一次偷窃。

examples.en: I get along with my classmates at school.
examples.zh: 我在学校和同学们和睦相处。

examples.en: She gets on with her new neighbors very well.
examples.zh: 她和她的新邻居们相处得很好。

examples.en: Do you get along with your brother?
examples.zh: 你和你的兄弟相处得好吗？

examples.en: Thieves broke into her home and took her jewellery box.
examples.zh: 盗贼闯入她家，拿走了她的珠宝盒。

examples.en: Women used to wear gold jewellery and make-up, but not now.
examples.zh: 女人们过去常戴金珠宝和化妆，但现在不了。

examples.en: I took a course and learned to make silver jewellery.
examples.zh: 我上了一门课，学会了制作银珠宝。

examples.en: She admitted stealing the money from her boss.
examples.zh: 她承认偷了老板的钱。

examples.en: More cars are stolen every year now.
examples.zh: 现在每年有更多的汽车被盗。

examples.en: They were so poor they had to steal to eat.
examples.zh: 他们太穷了，不得不偷东西吃。
